1080: Amar ribbi yehuda, mahu dekudesha berich hu anish leh ledavid al yeda divreh, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 12:11) hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetecha. amar ribbi yose, ha okimna, begin dei yekum aleh bar nash ochora, la yerachem aleh. amar leh, veha avshalom baa lekatla leavuy bechamma etin bishin (davar) aleh, yattir mibbar nash ochora. amar leh la shemana.

Amar leh, ana shemana, david chata bevat sheva setam. amar kudesha berich hu, lete bera devat el nichar, veyinkom nukemata, uman ihu. da avshalom, dibberah diyfat toar hava, mikkerava. mikkan olifna, man denatil itteta da bikrava, vechamid ba, lesof nafik minnah ben sorer umore. may tama begin dead kean, la paska minnah zuhama, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 62:8) nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, kol zimna debar nash chate kamme dekudesha berich hu, it darga deishtemoda leella lokovle hay chattaa, ledayyeyna leh lebar nash, veistakkal (sefer acher vaasatekan) aleh, i tav bityuveta shelemata kame mareh, itavar choveh, vedina la shalta aloy, vela mate aloy. i la tav, itreshim hahu chattaa legabbe hahu darga. osif lemechote, ha darga ochora izdeman lekavleh, veistekam bedarga kadmaa, keden baya teshuva yattir. (vei lo 402) vei osif lemechete, osif darga al darga, ad deashlim lachamisha dargin.

Kevan deittekan yemina lokovleh, veistekam aleh. ha semala zemina, leaskema bimina, uleitkallela beh. kevan dismala istekam bimina, keden la talya bitshuva, veha ukemuha, ucheden kolla istekamu aleh bedina, vdina sharya aleh.

Vchad dina ishtelim vesharya aleh debar nash, keden istayaym veittekanu etzbean, chamesh bego chamesh, yemina bismala, leachazaa deha kolla istechamu aleh behahu dina, veyadoy mityashsheran, leachazaa milla bela kavavna debar nash, vela yitkeuvn beh. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev. leitkallela semala bimina, veashlim dina, ucheden hu kayyayma decholla. veal da, kad baa kudesha berich hu lekayyeyma kolla, ketiv (Yeshayahu 62:8) nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda patach, ketiv (vaykareakeg) peri etz hadar kappot temarim. peri etz hadar, man hu. da etrog. vechi etrog meetz hadar hu, veha kama kotzin it sacharaneh, mikkan umikkan, veat amrat peri etz hadar. ella raza demilla, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:22) vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela asher lakach min haadam leishsha vayvieha el haadam. uchetiv (Bereshit 2:23) etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari, veda hu peri etz hadar. menalan deadam etz ikre. dichtiv, (Devarim 20:19) ki haadam etz hassade.

Kappot temarim, desalik leshivin shenin, uveh ishtachlalu shivin shenin illain. veda achpat veitkeshar leella vetatta. veal da ikre kappot, kema deat amer kefitu, desalik lehacha ulehacha. hada hu dichtiv ki chol bashshamayim uvaaretz dayyka.

Ribbi yose amar, peri etz hadar da mizbeach, deavid perin, vesalik evin lechol sitrin. may taama. begin dechol 70 shenin, yahavin lah chulaka, veitbarcha mekullehu. may ka mayyre. begin deman dechate legabbe mizbeach, becholla chate, deha kafit lokovle hahu dechafit leella, veal da itkeshar da beda, peri etz hadar kappot temarim vela ketiv vechappot temarim.

Ketiv (Vayikra 7:35) zot mishchat aharon umishchat banav. may ka mayyre. ella, zot: da mizbeach, deitmeshach al yeda deaharon, dichtiv, (shamevatem) umashachta et mizbach haola veet kol kelav. umishchat (sefer acher zo mishchat) banav, deha mekullehu itmeshach, veitrabbe, veitbarcha, veitdakka.

Ta chazi, bechag sovvim et hammizbeach zimna chada bechol yoma, veshiva zimnin levatar. may ka mayyre. ella, lemalka dezammin ushepizin, veitasak behu, vahava leh lemalka bat yechidaa, amra leh, mari malka, begin ushepizin la ishgachta alay. amar leh, chayyayich beratti parketa chada aslik lach bechol yoma, (deshavve kechullehu).
1081: Kacha, bechol yoma veyoma dechag, makrivin yisrael lokovel umin dealma. amar mizbeach lemalka kaddisha, lechullehu mishtakkeche manin vechulakin, veli ma ant yahiv. amar lah, bechol yoma veyoma yesovvun lech shiva yomin illain, levarcha lach, veyahavin lach shivin chulakin (bechol yoma), rabbi yose amar shavin chulakin bechol yoma lokovel shivin parim demitkarvin bechag.

Ribbi yehuda amar, shiva bechol yoma, begin deha itbarcha (meatar) mikkullehu, ulesof, shiva yomin, mitbarcha meatar dimshach revuta ishtechach. (ulevatar) shiva zimnin, lokovel kol innun shiva yomin, begin lekayyeyma lah birchan min mabbua denachala, denagid tadir vla pasik, ishtechach deitbarcha (tadir) bechol yoma veyoma, ad shiva yomin deitbarcha mimmabbua denachala. vechen zimna ochora shiva zimnin kachada veitkeyaymu birchan levatar meatar illaa demabbua nafik vela pasak, kidkamran.

Bechol yoma, machrizin ala veamrin, (Shmuel 1 2:Adonai) ad akara yalda shiva verabbat banim umlala. ad akara yalda shiva: da keneset yisrael, deitbarcha mishshiva bechol yoma, vesalik lechusheban illaa. verabbat banim umlala, illen umin ovde avoda zara, desallekin beyoma kadmaa lechusheban rav, ulevatar mitmaatin veazlin bechol yoma veyoma. veal da, mizbeach mechapper al chovehon deyisrael mizbeach madke lehon, vearik lehon birchan meella letatta.

Vaanaf etz avot: da malka kaddisha, deachid litren sitrin. uvegin kach hadas telat anaf, deyitaved anaf etz avot, deachid lechol sitra. vearve nachal: illen teren kayymin, demehacha nafik, lechappot temarim. kappot temarim, achid leella veachid letatta, veha ittemar. etrog nafka miggo kuvin deilana vehachi hu. kappot temarim hachi name achid behu vadday, kol ma denafik lealma mehacha nafka umehacha atyayn. (sefer acher ittezan)

Ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 43:4) veavoa el mizbach elohim. man mizbach elohim. da hu mizbeach dilella, mizbach elohim vadday. vehayeynu beer deyitzchak. ulezimnin mizbach Adonai, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 8:54) kam millifne mizbach Adonai, veal da yartin almin mehacha dina verachame, begin dehi yanka behay sitra uvehay sitra, veha ukemuha milla.

(Vayikra Adonai:15) nefesh ki timol maal vegomer, ribbi yitzchak amar, ha ukemuha nefesh vday. ketiv (Shmuel 1 25:29) vhayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim et Adonai elohecha, uchetiv vet nefesh oyvecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala.

Zakkain innun tzadikayyay deit lon chulaka illaa bekudesha berich hu, bechulaka kadisha, bekiddushe malka, begin deinnun mekaddeshe garmayyhu bekiddushe demarehon. vechol man deitkaddash, kudesha berich hu mekaddesh leh, dichtiv (Vayikra 20:7) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. bar nash mekaddesh garmeh millera, mekaddeshin leh milleella, vechad itkaddash bar nash bikdusha demareh, malbishin (nusach acher yartin) leh nishmeta kadisha, achasana dekudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael, ucheden yarit kolla. veillen deikrun benin lekudesha berich hu, kema dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze ketiv (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya, veokmuha (19 amud alef) nefesh chayya setam. umehahu chulaka yarit david malka, veitkeshar bekishshura illaa, veachasin malchuta, kema deittemar. uvegin kach vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim. veha ukemuha denefesh itkeshar

Raya mehemna pikkuda da, hammoel behekdesh tzarich lehavi keren vechomesh. hada hu dichtiv, veet chamishito yosef alav keren 6. chomesh dileh Adonai. vda (Yehoshua 6) keren hayyovel. keren dehava bemitztzecheh dehahu par dehikriv adam harishon. hay, ihu ikkara dechol karbanayya. hakkeren kayyemet lo leolam habba, uferot dileh bealma den. vda Adonai Adonai. (ad kan 310)
1082: Beruach, veruach binneshama, uneshama bekudesha berich hu. zakkaa chulakeh man deyarit yeruta da illaa.

Vavy leinnun rashiayya denafshan dilhon la zakkan bealma den, kol shekken bealma deate. alayyhu ketiv (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala. deazlan veshatan bealma, vela ashkechan atar lenayycha, leitkashshera beh, veistaavan (nusach acher vaashateaben) bego sitra dimsaavuta, vecharoza kare veamar, nefesh ki timol maal baAdonai mikdash Adonai timme. deha bikdushsha la ayel, vela itkelil. veinnun mazzike alma, begin demitdabbekan behu, umistaavan.

Ribbi yitzchak, amar ha ukemuha, nefesh, kad mitattera keneset yisrael bemalka kadisha, itattar, veikre tzerora dechayye, begin devah itkeshar kolla. ribbi elazar amar, shechinta kad natla, baavahata natla, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 14:19) vyyissa malach haelohim haholech vegomer.

Ribbi abba amar, kolla itavid chad atara, begin deyitattar kachada, ushema kadisha itchaze begavavyyhu (sefer acher bagevavenay). behahi shaata, ikre (Shir HaShirim 2:3) ketafuach baatze hayyaar ken dodi ben habbanim. vahavu chaman yisrael ziv yekara illaa natil kamayyhu, veda hu detanenan, (Devarim 4:37) vayyotziacha befanav bechocho haggadol mimmitzrayim. illen avahata, uvegin kach, hay shema matbar turin, umatbar tinarin, veit beh letav ulevish. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Ta chaze, ez lekarbena, amay. veha amar ribbi shimon, ez shema dileh garim, leolif min shemeh, deha sitra bisha zina bisha hu. ella hachi amar rabbi shimon, da bae lekarva, deha i abar aleh rucha dimsaava, o itassak beh, hay ez karbaneh, behahu gavvna deihu chate beh.

Vamar ribbi shimon, ha tanenan it man (Bereshit 69 amud alef, Shemot 24 amud bet veayyen 91) dezacha binneshama, veit man dezacha beitaruta deruach, veit man dela zache ella benefesh. hay man dela zache ella benefesh, vela salik yatir, ha itdebak behahu sitra misava, vechad ihu naim, innun sitrin bishin atyayn umitdabbekan beh, umodin leh bechelma millin dealma. minnehon kedivin, uminnehon keshot. ulezimnin dechayychan beh, veachziu leh mile shekar, vetzarin leh bechelmeh. veal da umin ovde avoda zara, minnehon dechaman bechelmayyhu mile keshot, begin hahu sitra demitdabbekan beh. vechullehu millin lizman kariv.

Ta chaze, beilen zinin bishin, it telat dargin, illen al illen. darga illaa dilhon hanehu detalyaan (76 amud bet Shemot 267 amud alef, 261 amud alef, 91 amud bet) baavira. darga tattaa dilhon innun dechayychan bivne nasha, vetzaaran lehu bechelmayyhu, begin dechullehu chatzifin kechalve. veit darga illaa alayyhu, deinnun meillae vetattae, villen modae leh lebar nash millin, minnehon kedivin, uminhon keshot. veinnun mile dikshot kullehu lizman kariv.

Vehahu darga meinnun detalyayn baavira, deinnun illain yattir. hahu dela zache yattir ella benefesh, vehahu nefesh bae leittakkena lekabbela rucha, ad la ravavch leh, nafka ma denafka mehahu nefesh, veitpeshshat bealma, uvaa lesalleka, vela bae, ad deara behu beinnun daavira, veinnun modiin leh millin, minnehon kerivin, uminhon rechikin yatir, uvehahu darga azil veitkeshar bechelmeh, ad dekani ruach.

Kevan dekana rucha, hahu rucha nafik, metavar turin vetinarin, salik veitpashshat veail ben malache illae kadishe, vetamman yada ma deyada, veolif millin, veithaddar leatreh. keden hu kishshura debar nash bikdushsha, ad dezache banneshama vekane lah.

Kevn dekana neshama, hi salleka leella leella, uneture pitchin la meakkeve lah, veazla umitpashsheta veayyla ben innun tzadikayya ditzriran bitzrora dechayye, vetamman chame innuga demalka umithanya min ziva illaa.

Vchad itar ayyaylta kadisha, beruach tzafon, nachta, vekam hahu zakkaa dekane lah, veitgabbar kearye takkifa beorayyta, ad deate tzafra, veazil behahi ayyaylta kadisha leitchazaa kame malka, lekabbela chad chuta dechesed, umay
1083: Ihu da chuta deavraham, dehu kane leh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 14:23) im michut vead seroch naal, hu la ithane meochora kelum, veamar im michut, zacha lehay chuta, veda ikre chuta deavraham.

Vechad ate hahu zakkaa behay ayyaylta, keden itattar immah kame malka, vedavid kaamar, (Tehillim 22:1) lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar, da keneset yisrael, ayyelet hashshachar shirata dichneset yisrael, dekaamre begaluta eli eli lama azavtani vegomer.

Amar rabbi shimon, zakkain innun mare denishmeta, mare deorayyta, bene pulechana demalka kadisha. vavy leinnun chayyayvayya, dela zakkan leitdabbeka bemarihon, vela zakkan beorayyta, dechol man dela zache beorayyta, la zache la beruach, vela binneshama. veitdabbekuta dilhon, behahu sitra dezinin bishin. vehay let leh chulaka bemalka kadisha, let leh chulaka dikdushsha. vavy leh kad yippuk mehay alma, deha ishtemoda hu legabbe innun zinin bishin, mare chatzifuta, takife kechalba, sheluche denura degehinnam, dela merachame alayyhu.

Ta chaze, ma ben yisrael leammin ovde avoda zara. yisrael, af al gav dela zache bar nash yisrael, ella benefesh, darga illaa kaim aleh, vei ihu bae lemikni ruach, vei ihu bae lemikni neshama, kane vezache bah. aval ammin ovde avoda zara, la kanyayn lealmin, bar i itgezar, dekane nefesh (tachat nefesh) meatar ochora.

Vysrael dekayyme bedarga tattaa benefesh, i ihu la bae lemizke yattir, onsheh sagya. vavy lehahu chayyayva, deanshe pikkude deorayyta, vela ishtedal beorayyta, anshe lemareh, aleh ketiv (Tehillim 104:35) yittammu chattaim min haaretz.

Vta chaze it bene nasha deitdabbekan behay sitra, begin hahu (nusach acher behay) nefesh dela zakkan yattir, vechad abar alayyhu hahu rucha misava, ashre alayyhu veitdebaku beh. keden hahu chattaa dechate bar nash, hu missitra dehahu ruach misava, vekarbanih ihu chad ez, begin deihu beira deate mehahu sitra, lechappera al choveh.

Amar leh ribbi elazar berih, vha ketiv (Devarim 21:23) lo talin nivlato al haetz vegomer, velo tetamme et admatcha. begin deara hi kadisha, (uveatra deshari) veruach misava la yishtechach atra beara kadisha lemishre aloy, i hachi, kevan dehahu beira share aleh ruach misava veate missitraha, amay makrivin leh listar kudesha. amar leh yaut shaalta.

Aval ta chaze beri, ketiv (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu, it eshsha achil eshsha. eshshata dekudesha berich hu, achil eshsha ochora. veta chaze it malachin deamrin shirata kame kudesha berich hu, veinnun mitbatle kad mesayyeyme hahi shirata, benitzotza deeshsha achla. letatta zammin kudesha berich hu eshsha demadbecha, vehay eshsha achla veshetze lechol hahu sitra, veitbattal hahu sitra, behahu shalhova deesha, vela ashar minneh bealma. vehahu bar nash dimkarev karbaneh, kaim aleh, uvehahu recha dekarbena desalik, itabbar minneh sitra deruach misava desharya aloy, veyitkapper. begine kach kolla itbetil vyishtetze, vlet man dekaim legabbe hahu eshsha.

Ribbi acha hava azil beorcha, veribbi chiyyay veribbi yose arau kachada. amar ribbi acha, vday anan telat, zeminin lekabbela anpe shechinta, itchabbaru kachada veazlu. amar ribbi acha, kol chad vechad lema milla diktura deorayyta vnezil.

Patach ribbi chiyyay veamar, (Yeshayahu 45:8) hareifu shamayim mimmaal vegomer, hay kera raza hu dechachmeta, deolifna mibbutzina kadisha. hareifu shamayim mimmaal. may hareifu. kema deat amer (Devarim 32:2) yaarof kammatar likchi. veal sitra demitra dehu mezona decholla kaamar. veal da, kol eni alma metzappan lekudesha berich hu limzone, begin deihu yahiv mezona lecholla, vzan kol, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 145:15) ene chol elecha yesabberu vegomer.

Vei tema divatar da deikre shamayim talya milleta. ha taninan, delav bizchuta talya milleta. uzechuta, ha ukemuha tzedaka. vetargum tzedaka, zechuta. uzechuta veshamayim chad milla hu, vhacha hareifu shamayim. (vei tema beh talya) ketiv mimmaal, mimmaal vadday, meattika kaddisha ka
1084: Atya, vela mehahu atar deikre shamayim, veikre zechuta, ella mimmaal dayyka.

Ushechakim yizzelu tzedek, dechad shamayim natil leh mimmaal, mehahu atar illaa deshari aloy, keden shechakim yizzelu tzedek. man shechakim. atar detachanin mana letzaddikayyay. umay ninhu. netzach vehod, deinnun vadday tachanin mana letzaddikayyay. leman. lehahu atar deikre tzaddik deha innun tachanin leh lehahu mana deatya milleella, vechol hahu tivu mitkenish begavvyyhu, lemehav leh ledarga detzaddik, begin deyitbarchun tzedek mehahu nezilu dilhon, veal da tachanin mana letzaddikayyay. man tzaddikayyay da tzaddik vetzedek, yosef vrachel, dechad mizdavvevgan kachada tzaddikim ikru.

Veillen tachanin mana letzaddikayyay vadday, veal da ushechakim yizzelu tzedek. keden tiftach eretz letatta. veyifru yesha, bene alma. utzedaka tatzmiach yachad, kol rachame, vechol tivu dealma sagiu, umezonayyhu divne nasha mishtakkeche bealma, keden chedva al chedva ittosaf, vechol almin mitbarchan. amar ribbi acha, ilmale la atena ella lemishma da dayyay.

Patach ribbi yose vamar, (Shoftim Adonai:9) libbi lechokke yisrael hammitnaddevim baam barachu Adonai. ta chazi, kol reuta, vechol libba, devae bar nash learka birchan meella letatta, leyachada shema kaddisha. live bitzlota lekudesha berich hu biruta uvechavana delibba, lenagda mehahu nachala amika, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 130:1) mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai, detamman umeka decholla, baamike illae, deinnun sheruta illaa, deabba veima mizdavvevgin. uf hacha libbi lechokke yisrael, man chokke yisrael. la ketiv chakuke yisrael, ella lechokke. illen abba veima, deinnun mechokke leyisrael kaddisha, deihu nagid mibbenayyhu.

Hammitnaddevim baam, illen innun avahan, deikrun nedivim, kema deat amer (Tehillim 47:10) nedive ammim neesafu am elohe avraham. keden barachu Adonai, lenagda minneh birchan letatta, veyishtachchun birchan bealma kullehu, dechad hacha mishtakkechin birchan milella kolla hu bechedvavta kolla hu bishlimu. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu merik alehon birchan, vetzayit tzelothon, vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 102:18) pana el tefillat haarar velo vaza et tefillatam vegomer.
1085: Mistappeke veittezanu, leitkashshera rucha ochora, deihi go mesaavu, meinnun tarbin veshamnunin, kema deittemar. uvegin kach ola kodesh kodashim, shear karbenin lemebad shelama bealma kullehu, mikkamma sitrin umare dedinin. leitabbera uleitnahara miggo reuta leitbassema, ikrun kodashim kalim, begin dela mitattere leella leella bakkodesh hakkodashim. veal da innun kodashim kalim, unechisu dilhon bechol atar kema deukemuha, aval ola deihi raza dekodesh hakodashim, lav ihi kishar karbenin, dechol ovadaha kodesh.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv velavash hakkohen mido vad, illen levushin meyachadin likdushsha. bad yechiday, meyachada likdusha. uchetiv bigde kodesh hem verachatz bammayim et besaro ulevesham. may tama da kodesh. ella raza demilla, kidkaamar deihi kodesh kodashim, desalleka kolla veitattera bekkodesh hakkodashim, bekishshura chada. ulevatar mafne veabar ruach misava, dimsaev kolla, dela shalta, vela yitkeriv go makdesha, veitabbar mikkol sitre dekudesha, veishtear kolla kodesh bikdushsha yechiday.

Veamar rabbi shimon, ha ittemar, (58 64) dichtiv, (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai. vehachi salleka raza deadam, missitra deadam. behema, missitra divhema. uvegin kach ketiv adam ki yakriv mikkem. adam vday, deha karbaneh leella, lekashshera kishra. ulevatar min habbehema. vecholla ihu bakkera, adam uvehema. veda ihu raza, deitzterich lekarbena adam uvehema, kidkaamar. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, hachi aved adam uvehema.

Vei tema veha ketiv (Bereshit 1:20) veof yeofef al haaretz, deha minnayyhu mekarvin karbena, vaafillu ola, kema dichtiv veim min haof ola karbano. ta chaze, mikkol innun ofin la mekarvin ella min hattorim o bene yona. ella raza da, ma deitkeshar beda, pasil beda. da yemina, veda semala, vecholla chad.

Of yeofef al haaretz, ha okimna deinnun raza dirticha. uvehu tistallak ruach hakkodesh, lesalleka leella. deinnun tere, chad limina, vechad lismala. of limina, veda michael. yeofef lismala, veda gavriel. da limina, veda lismala.

Uvegin kach mekarvin teren illen, lesalleka ruach kudesha, usemala meatter vezayin letatta, lehahu setar semala. vimina limina. veitkashsherat itteta bevalah, lemehevi chad. vecholla mistelak umitkeshar kachada, leella vetatta vekudesha berich hu istallak bilchodoy veittakaf.
Uvesifre kadmae, miskena la yahiv chulaka leittezna, ella leella leitkashshera, aval kolla leella vetatta kol chad mitkashshar lesitreh kedka yeot, veha okimna.

(Shemot 239 amud bet) ribbi elazar shail lerabbi shimon avoy veamar, ha kishshura decholla itkeshar bakkodesh hakodashim leitnahara, itdabbekuta deraava dechahane levae veyisrael leella, ad hechan ihu salleka.

Amar leh ha okimna, ad en sof, dechol kishshura veyichuda ushelimu, leatznea behahu tzeniu, dela itdebak, vela ityeyda, deraava dechol raavin beh. en sof la kayyeyma leodaa, vela lemebad sof, vela lemebad rosh deayin. (nusach acher rosh kema deen) kadmaa, appik rosh vesof, man rosh. da nekuda illaa, deihi resha decholla setimaa, dekayyeyma go machashava. veavid sof, deikre sof davar, aval lehatam en sof.

Lav reutin, lav nehorin, lav butzinin behahu en sof, kol illen nehorin uvutzinin talyayn leitkayyeyma behu, vela kayyme leitdabbeka, man deyada vela yada, lav ihu ella reu illaa setimaa dechol setimin, ayin.

Vechad nekuda illaa, vealma deate, istelaku, la yadin bar recha, keman dearach berecha veitbesam, velav da nayycha (sefer acher nichoach), deha ketiv (Vayikra 26:31) vela ariach bereach nichochachem, deha reach nichoach recha diruta, dechol hane reuta ditzlota, ureuta deshirata, ureuta dechahane, dechullehu raza deadam, keden kullehu itavidu reuta chada, vehahu ikre nichoach, reuta: ketargumo. keden kolla itkeshar veitnehir kachada kedka yeot, kema deittemar.
Veal da ityehivat hay sitra ochora bida dechahana, dichtiv,
1086: Tzav et aharon veet banav lemor. raza hacha, deha okimna, let tzav ella avoda zara. vehacha ityeyhivat leh leittokda hahu machashava raa, uleabera lah miggo kudesha, behay reuta desalleka leella, uvehay tenana vetarbin deittokdan, begin leitabbera min kudesha, vehay tzav birshutayyhu kayyeyma, leafresha lah min kudesha miggo hay karbena vei tema tzav et bene yisrael, hachi name deha birshutayyhu kayyeyma, (sefer acher leafrasha la min kudesha) kol zimna deavde reuta demarehon, dela yachla leshalletaa alayyhu.

Vehay kera kolla atya leachazaa raza demilla, leattera lehay ruach kudesha leella leella, uleafresha lah leda ruach tumea, lenachta lah letatta letatta. da biruta uvitzlota kidkaamaran, veda beovada kolla kidkachaze leh.

Vehay kera mochacha alayyhu, dichtiv tzav et aharon veet banav lemor. tzav: da avoda zara, ruach misava. (Bereshit 38, 58, 60) lemor: da itteta, deikre yirat Adonai. ketiv hacha lemor, uchetiv hatam (Yirmeyahu 3:1) lemor hen yeshallach ish et ishto. veha okmuha. begin kach kolla ittemar, vechahana kayyeyma leittakna kolla beraza deadam uvehema.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay bealma den uvealma deate, deinnun yade orche deorayyta, veazle bah beorach keshot, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 38:16) Adonai alehem yichyu. man alehem. illen arche deorayyta. yichyu: yitkayyeymun, bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, ketiv zot torat haola, amar ribbi chiyay, hay kera okimna leh behay gavvna, (zot torat, da keneset yisrael. haola: dehi salleka, vametaatarea leella leella, leitkashshera kedka yeot, ad atar deikre kodesh kadashim.)

(Davar achar) zot torat, da keneset yisrael. haola: da machashava raa, deihi salleka al reuta debar nash leastaa leh meorach keshot, hi haola, hi desalleka veastiat leh levar nash, uvae leokda lah benura. begin dela yityeyhiv lah ducheta leastaa.

Uvegin kach, al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla. man layla. da keneset yisrael. deihi zot, begin deate ledakkea lebar nash mehahu reuta. al mokda, begin denahar dinur ihu atar leokda lechol innun dela kayyme bekiyyumayyhu, deha alin lon behahu nura dedalik, umeabbere shuletanehon mealma, uvegin dela yishlot, itzterich al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla, veitkafya vela shalta.

Veal da, kad itkafya hay, salleka keneset yisrael, deihi ruach kudesha, desalleka veitattera leella, deha seliku dilah, kad itkafya hay chela ochora, veitperash minnah. uvegin kach baenan beraza dekarbena, leafresha lehay sitra, meruach kudesha, ulemehav lah chulaka, begin deruach kudesha tistallak leella.

Ribbi acha patach veamar, vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo vegomer, vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo, amay. uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker, amay. vechahana amay. veha tanenan eshsha bechol atar dina hu, vechahana missitra dimina ka ate, urechika hu min dina, deha kahana la izdeman bedina lealmin, vehacha hu bae leokda dina bealma, dichtiv uvier aleha hakkohen.
Ella hachi olifna, bar nash deate lemechote kame mareh, hu okid garmeh beshalhovita deyetzer hara. veyetzer hara missitra deruach

Raya mehemna pikkuda laasot haola kemishpatah, vealah ittemar zot torat haola vegomer. chamesh ishim havo nachtin al karbena. esh ochel veeno shote. esh shote veeno ochel. esh ochel veshote. esh ochel lachim vyveshim. esh sheeno ochel veeno shote. lokkovlayyhu innun, zot torat haola, chad. hi haola al mokda, 2. al hammizbeach, 3. kol hallayla, 4. veesh hammizbeach tukad bo Adonai.
Veukemuha mare matnitin, ola kulah salleka laggavoah. veda bina, Adonai, Adonai marot dilah. 10, bat yechida, (Shemot 24:17) umare kevod Adonai keesh ochelet. 6 or devat ena, vehi esh
1087: Misava ka atya, veha sharya beh ruach misava. ulezimnin ishtemodan karbane deatyayn mehay sitra, uvaa lekarva al madbecha kiddame leh. vela ishtetze, vela itbetal hahu ruach misava, ben mibbar nash, uven mehahu sitra deate minneh, ella beeshsha demadbecha, dehahu eshsha mevaara ruach misava, vezinin bishin mealma, vechahana beda itkevavn, letakkena eshsha divaer zinin bishin mealma.

Veal da bae, dela yidachun leh lealmin, vela yitchalesh chela vetukepa dileh, letavra chela detukepa ochora bisha mealma, veal da lo tichbe. vechahana yesader aleh eshsha babboker babboker, bezimna deshalta sitra dileh veittear bealma, begin levassema alma (sefer acher ulevassema dina), veitkafyayn dinin, vela mitare bealma, veal da tanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. eshsha dilella achla eshsha ochora, eshsha demadbecha achla eshsha ochora, veal da, eshsha da la tichbe lealmin, vechahana mesadder leh bichol yoma.

Shote kol mayin deorayyta, veochelet kol karbenin ditztzelota. veochelet lachin viveshin, innun peshate deorayyta deinnun keetztzim yeveshim. verazi orayyta innun keetztzim lachim. vehay ihu esh ochelet lachin viveshin.

Veod ochelet lachin, kol karbenin dahavo kerevin bitztzelota, al mitztzevot ase. viveshin, kol karbenin dahavo kerevin bitztzelota, al mitztzevot lo taase. vehay ihu, sekila serefa hereg vechenek, al mitztzevot ase, veal mitztzevot lo taase, illen innun karbenayya dishchinta, tzelota, defikkudin daase vela taase. velokovel Adonai marot illen, takkinu chamesh tzelote beyoma dechippure. velokovel bat ena, innun aseret yeme hatteshuva Adonai lokovel or devat ena. Adonai innuyin, lokovel Adonai batraa.

Pikkuda batar da, laasot hachatat kemishpatah. tannaim vaamoraim, attun demisitra demidot dekudesha berich hu atitu, detarchatun sagge lenakkaa beratta dili deihi halacha, meillen kelifin, deerev rav, kusheyayn bishin, delet lon tirutz, vela piroka, dealayyhu ittemar, (Kohelet 1:15) meuvvat lo yuchal litkon, vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot, ella ittemar tiku behon. vechol tiku deisura lechumera, veihu tiku chaser 50 delet leh tikkun. chaser nun, deihi alma deate, detiku dealma deate, shetika. kegon shetok kach ala bemachashava.

Veit kusheyayn deinnun levushin dahalacha, deittemar behon mishbetztzot zahav. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 45:14) kol kevudda bat melech penima mimmishbetztzot zahav levushah. veattun, paskin lon bechamma pesakot, ulevatar metakkenin umefarkin lon bechamma pirukin.

Vei chaser shum pesak mimmatnitin, kemma deukemuha ze chaser min hammishna, attun metakkenin lon, vehay hu chesron sheuchal lehimmanot. vei yite tippesh veyappik shum bish al hahu umana dechatich levushin, veyima vechi orayyta ihi chaser, veha ketiv (tehillim 19) torat Adonai temima, temima bechol evarin degufa, deinnun 248 pikudin. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:7) kullach yafa rayati umum en bach. temima bilvushaha, veech chaser min hammishna.

Attun temrun leh, dok vetishkach chaticha, vetishkach lah meurevet bishar pesakot umishnayot. deorach umana lemechtach levushin bechamma chatichot, vetalmid delav ihu baki lemikshar hahalacha beillen chatichot, mitchallefe leh pesakot vekusheyayn, vela ashkach lon piruka. ad deyite umana, ufarik lon kol illen sefekot dilhon. behahu zimna, halacha deihi beratta, selikat kodam malka, shelema becholla, begufa bilvusha uvetachshitaha, veitkayyaym bah (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam. ulezimnin it leumana talmid baki, dishadder leh letakkena lon.

Kamu kullehu veamru, vadday ant hu umana raya mehemna. deittemar bach moshe kibbel tora missinay, umittamman veelach kullehu talmidim innun dilach, min yehoshua ad sof kol darin. hada hu deamar umesarah liyhoshua, vihoshua lizkenim, uzekenim linviim, ad sof kullehu. talmid baki dilach man hu ha chazena deittemar, hakkol yehe munach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Amar lon, vadday hachi hu, deihu talmid chaver, dealeh ittemar (Bamidbar 25:7) ben aharon hakkohen. kegavvna deittemar beaharon (Shemot 4:16) hu yihye lecha lefe,
1088: Hachi name bereh, yihye li lefe, deihi orayyta dival pe. begin dehechi dahavena bekadmita kevad pe uchevad lashon, vehachi yokim li kudesha berich hu, kevad pe beorayyta debal pe, uchevad lashon beorayyta shebbichtav, dela yemrun illen dela ishtemodin li, ochora ihu. veeliyyahu hu yihye li lefe, yete letakkena kol illen sefekot, ulefarka lon.

Behahu zimna, zot torat haola, beratta, dahavat mehaddeka shefala begaluta, selikat al kol dargin dilella, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:29) rabbot banot asu chayil veat alit al kullana, useliku dilah tehe leabba deihu limina chesed, deveh harotze lehachekim yadrim, mittamman chachma, 28 45.

Amar chad tana, bevadday begin da ittemar bach, molich limin moshe begin kalla dilach, dela yehe lach shelimu ella bah. dechad ant tehe shelema bah, ittemar bach (Bamidbar 12:8) pe el pe adabber bo umare vela vechidot. bemare: kegavvna dechalla deitpashshetat malbushaha, umityaychedet im balah bekeruv basar, beramach evarim dilah, vela kassiat ever chad minnah. vehay ihu bemare 248 bechusheban. (nusach acher itchaze la deittemar beh)

Amar butzina kaddisha, bekadmita itchaze lach hay chezu, deittemar bah bemare, deihu lach hamare haggadol bassene, deidkar beh chamishsha zimnin hassene. uchean itgalya lach chezu da, beramach pikudin, deinnun bechamsha chumashe tora. velo vechidot, deinnun levushin dilah, divhon chazu kol nevie. delet orach leitgallaa kalla bekeruv basar, ella lechatan dilah.

Behahu zimna yitkayyaym behu, (Bereshit 2:25) vayyihyu shenehem arummim haadam veishto velo yitboshashu. kegon adam veishto dichvar itabbar irbuveya bisha, erev rav, kusheya bisha mealma, deinnun eryayn dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, eryayn deyisrael. kol shekken eryayn dilach raya mehemana. umehalacha dilach. divginayyhu tzarich lechassaa razin deorayyta, kema deukemuha (Mishlei 25:2) kevod elohim haseter davar, ad demitabberin mealma. velet melachim ella yisrael, kema deukemuha, kol yisrael bene melachim hem, behahu zimna, uchevod melachim chakor davar. amar raya mehemana, berich ant leattik yomin, demittamman ant, keanpa deitpeshshat meilana, hachi nishmatin anpa minneh.

Tannaim veamorain, ha vadday ola vechatat veasham, telat pikudin innun, telat avahan. shelamim matronita. ever, deihi tashlumin dechol ever, kegavvna deyoma kadmaa dechag. (sefer acher atar deihu tashlumim decholla kegavvna).

Mi shello chag beyom tov rishon, en tashlumim larishon, ushear yomin tashlumin ze baze, uvehon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot aval mi shello chag yom tov harishon shel chag aleh ittemar (Kohelet 1:15) meuvvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot. vehay ihu chatat dimakkev laola. (may tama) chet ihu dechar. chatat, nukeba. ulezimnin deha itbesam chatat, veitperash meola. behahu sair, deittemar (Bamidbar 15:24) useir izzim echad lechatat.

Asham taluy achid betarvavyyhu, keman deachid lechan ulechan, veihu taluy beemtztzaita. kegon, hakkol taluy ad sheyyavo eliyyahu, veyafrish le mittamman. hachi asham taluy, ihu achid betarvavyyhu, ad deyahavin leh mezona dileh, shochad dileh, veyitperash mittamman, umitkarvin evarin dechalla da leda. dehachi ihu asham vechatat, kesirchot daachidan barea, vela mannichin lah lefarcha lesalleka legabbe ella, lenashba berucha dekudesha.

Se ihu leola, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:7) veayye hasse leola. veittemar beh (Shemot 12:5) se tamim zachar, hada hu dichtiv ish tamim. veha tzarich lemishal, deha se ihu limina, sair ihu lismala, dehayynu seir izzim echad lechatat, veit sair, veit sair. sair echad laAdonai, useir echad laazazil. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:8) venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot goral echad laAdonai vegoral echad laazazel. uvehahu seir, ittemar beesav, (Bereshit 27:11) ish sair. veda kaved. denatil kol innun shemarim dedam. (demittamman) shechin avabuot porchot, sappachot, vechol mine tzaraat. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:22) venasha hassair alav et kol avonotam el eretz gezira. veinnun avonot tam, deihu libba, ucheden itperash millearva belibba, ucheden itbesam, veihu kaved beillen chovin, vela kal lesalleka legabbe yaakov ish tam. chadu mare matnitin dimtivtan, deka nachte im tanain veamorain.

Kam chad minnayyhu veamar, raya mehemana, hav li reshu lemishal, batar dezachena lemishma millin yakkirin illen mippumach, deorayyta da denafkat mippumach (Mishlei 3:15) yekara hi mippeninim vechol chafatztzecha lo yishvu vah, veal kol da halacha hi velilmod ani tzarich. ha sair daazazil shappir, asham taluy bean atar ihu.

Amar leh, berich ant beri, shappir ka shaalt. ella, ma ammuda deemtztzaita, achid beh yemina usemala, deinnun chesed ugevura, kegufa deachid ben teren deroin devar nash. o kenesher, daachidan beh teren gadpin lefarcha behon. vechayyona, daachidat bah teren gadpin, deamtilat leorayyta, vegadpin
1089: Dilah lemitztzevot ase, uvehon hi haola, ufarchat leella. hachi pikudin dela taase, innun tefisu dilah, kegon tzipporim haneechazim bappach. vechol tafsin dilah, dimakkevin lah lefarcha, itkeriu sirchot keillen sirchot, dimakkeve lechanfe rea, lenashba.

Hachi asham. deyisrael achid begadpoy dishchinta, deinnun chevavn dechuresyay, dela tehe ola behon bezichvavn deyisrael, legabbe kudesha berich hu, umeakkevin lah, umachbidin gadpaa 418 418 chataot dilhon. veasham imma deerev rav, sircha achida bechuresyyay, detamman matronita, vela manchat lah lesalleka miggaluta. vezachvavn achidan bah lesalleka, ishtearat baavira, kegon sircha taluy baavira. veda ammuda deemtztzaita. (deihu avira) hachi asham taluy betztzaddik, deihu achid ben shemaya veara.

Chatat ihi yoteret hakkaved, achbidat ala bechataot, delichluchin dechovin deyisrael, kegavvna dechaved machbid shemarim, deinnun damim, al arkin delibba. hachi illen chataot, machbidin al gadpoy dishchinta, deinnun pikudin daase, dedamyayn lechanfe yona. lo taase kad innun machbidin al ase, deinnun kad chovin deyisrael merubbin mizzachvavn, ittemar beorayyta deihu gufa, (Daniel 8:12) vetashlech emet artztza, veihi tzoochat (Eicha 1:14) netanani Adonai bide lo uchal kum (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum.

Uvegin da, takkinu tannaim vaamoraim tzelotin baatar dekarbenin, leabera chataot vaashamot minnah. uvegin da takkinu tzelota deshacharit, kekarban hashshachar. utztzelota demincha, kekarban ben haarbayim. utztzelota dearvit, keemurim ufedarim dahavo mitakkelim kol hallayla. utelat avahan detakinu telat tzelotin, lokovel merkavta deinnun ketirin bah. kema deukemuha, haavot hen hen hamerkava, deinnun pene arye el hayyamin learbatam vegomer. (ad kan raya mehemana)

(Vayikra 6:6) esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach lo tichbe. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Bereshit 22:7) vayyomer yitzchak el avraham aviv vayyomer avi vayomer hinnenni veni vegomer, vayyomer vayyomer telat zimnin deyitzchak, vayyomer chad deavraham, amay hachi. ella, 3 lemaase bereshit, deinnun telat deyitzchak havo. vechad deavraham barvii, dichtiv hinnenni veni dechika (sefer acher vedayyka) hinnenni. uchetiv, (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim meorot chaser.

Vei tema vayyomer vayyomer yatir innun. ella, innun setimin havo bemachashava. veillen, itgalleyayn miggo chashocha. vayyomer yitzchak el avraham, uchetiv (Bereshit 1:3) vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. vayyomer avi, uchetiv vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim vihi mavdil ben mayim lamayim. vayyomer hinne haesh, vayyomer elohim yikkavu hammayim. vayyomer hinnenni, vayomer elohim yehi meorot.

Raya mehemna veod esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach vegomer. da orayyta, deittemar bah (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo cho devari chaesh neum Adonai. lo tichbe vadday, daavera ena mechabbah tora. aval avera mechabbah mitztzeva, uman deavid avera dimchabbah mitztzeva deihi ner, hachi mechabbah ner dileh, deittemar bah (Mishlei 20:27) ner Adonai nishmat adam migufeh, vehay hu kibbuy, deishtear gufa bachashocha. vehachi man desalik shechinta meatraha, garim (lechol haolam) kibbuy vachashocha lehahu atar. vachashocha ihi avera, (Mishlei 30:23) veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah.

Useliku demitztzeva missitra deamme haaretz, lehon mechabbah mitztzeva, lekayyem behon, (Shmuel 1 2:9) ureshaim bachoshech yiddamu. aval legabbe mare tora, let leh keviyyay olamit, behon denaharin lah bechamma razin deorayyta, deor raz itkere. umitztzevot deorayyta dimkayyeymin lah rabbanan, tora ihu legabbayyhu, layla veyomam la tichbe alayyhu, begin dimkayyeymin bah (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita bo yomam valayla.

Veashan desalik mippumayyhu bemille deorayyta, ihu ashan hammaaracha, dimsadderin lah, umaarichin lah legabbe balah, kegon (Bamidbar 8:2) behaalotcha et hannerot, deittemar behon lehaalot ner tamid. uveashan hammaaracha veanan hakketoret, deorayyta ashan dilah, yitar millibba, legabbe chachmeta, deihu kemocha, kegavvna daanana. deitaruta daanana millibba, hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 2:6) veed yaale min haaretz, ulevatar vehishka et kol pene haadama.
Hachi yitar ashan, mibbina, deihu belibba, deukemuha legabbeh, hallev mevin. vesalik legave chachma, deihi
1090: (Nusach acher bemocha) kemocha. (uman) umay ashan. (daat) da, ammuda deemtztzaita, daat, lev mevin daat.

Levatar denachit ashan, chachma legave bina, deinnun da lismala, veda limina. ihu nachit malle meabba veimma, malle 15, leokda etztzim deinnun talmide chachamim, missitra deetz chayyim, deinnun evarim degufa, detamman Adonai haetztzim vday, leokda lon beshalhovin deorayyta, deittemar beh (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai. beshalhovin dener mitztzeva birchimu. ad kan (157 amud bet tannaim vaamoraim vechulei)

Pikuda (shayych ladef 110 amud bet) lehakeriv bechol yoma temidin. vaavatreh lehadelik esh, hada hu dichtiv esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach lo tichbe. vaabbatreh, terumat haddeshen. vaavatreh, karvan neder o nedava. tannaim veamoraim, kol illen temidin, innun midot dekudesha berich hu, ditztzeriche lemehevi lon nayycha. veaf al gav dechol sefiran kullehu chad, mikkol makom, kol sefira usefira memana al shabbatot uzemanin veyomin tavin, vehahi midda deshuletanuta dehahu zimna, kol sefiran itkelilu ba, veitkeriu kullehu al shem hahi midda, bechesed chasadim, bigvura gevurot vehachi bechol mida.

Veit hashebatat melacha, kegon shor, deit leh ol. vachamor, deit leh masoy. ben ol malchut shamayim, kegon tefilin. ben ol malchut avodat kochavim umazzalot, kefum ovadayyhu, beillen yomin it lon hashebatat melacha venayycha. man dela itassak beorayyta uvefikkudin, it leh ol malchut avodat kochavim umazzalot. uman deitassak beorayyta uvefikkudin, it lon ol malchut shamayim, deihi Adonai batraa, malchut shamayim itkeriat.

Ol mitztzevot ihi vadday, begin devah itberiu kol biryayn dishmayya veara, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram. baAdonai beraam. vechad yete shabbat veyom tov, nachtat bina deihu 20, al Adonai, deihi malchut shamayim neshama yetera, veihu (Shemot 32:16) charut al halluchot. anochi bitztziat mitztzerayim, uferishat gadfaha al beratta, veal mashshiryayn dilah, veit lon nayycha. veittemar bemashshiryayn desamael venachash, (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmecha, ot tefilin veot shabbat, veot deyomin tavin, veot berit kullehu shekilin.

Veit ot deshadday, deihu metatron eved, vechamma avadin talyayn minneh, dimmana al illen deavdin pikkude al menat lekabbel peras. metatron umashshiryayn dileh memanan alayyhu. beginayyhu ittemar, (Shemot 23:12) lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha veavdecha vaamatcha. aval innun deavdin pikudin shello al menat lekabbel peras, innun benoy demalka umatronita. veinnun kitrin vetagin al resha, deavadin beyomin dechol. uveginayyhu ittemar udeishtammash betaga chalaf, vehazzar hakkarev legabbayyhu yumat. deshabbattot itkeriu legabbe avadin.

Uvegin da, im kevanim im kaavadim. im kevanim, deittemar behon (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. im kaavadim, (Vayikra 25) ki li vene yisrael avadim vela shear umin. aval innun chayayvaya dela mishtaddelin beorayyta umitztzevot, velet alayyhu ol tora veol tefilin, ushear pikudin, innun avadin leumin dealma, umishtaabbedin behu. kegon (Devarim 6:21) avadim hayinu lefaro bemitztzerayim.

Vei natre shabbatot veyamim tovim, ittemar behu vayotztzienu Adonai elohenu. veyitkayyaym behu, (Shemot 23:12) lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha, chamor batora uvemitztzevot, veyinnafesh ben amatcha uvehemtecha, am haaretz behema ikre. ulevatar deyiul garmeh techot adam battora, yitkayyaym beh (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai. im hu kassus derachiv aleh mareh, vesavil leh, vela mevaet bemareh.

Umay sevilu deam haaretz letalmid chacham. begin, detalmid chacham keyyom shabbat tzarich ihu, delet leh middileh, vei am haaretz savil leh bemamoneh, veitnehig beh kefum reuteh leshammesha leh, uleitnahaga befikkudin kefum reuteh, yitkayyem beh adam uvehema toshia Adonai. yoshia leh mishshod ugezela, yoshia leh mimmalach hammavt, dela shallit aleh, veyishchat leh besakkin pagum dileh. vechol man deshachit besakkin pagum, nevela ihu, deittemar beh lakkelev tashlichun oto, deihu samael.

Venefesh detalmid chacham itkeriat shabbat malketa, nefesh yetera deshabbat. veoneg dileh nishmat chayyim, veruach sichli. veinnun neshama yetera, ruach yetera, al neshama verucha venafsha, deinnun avadin, deshaltin begufa, deyomin dechol. neshama yetera, nishmat kol chay, (242 amud bet) keter berosh tzadik, deihu yom shabbat. uvehay neshama yetera tehallel yah, deinnun abba veimma, dealah ittemar, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha, begin deihu merkava leillat haillot, deihu mechusse vela shallit aleh ena, uvegin da ayin lo raata.
Rucha yetera, nahar denafik meeden, miven abba veimma. umahalacho chamesh mea shenin, umate lishtitaa deihu tzadik. lehashekot et haggan, deihi nefesh yetera, malchut.
Neshama deshalta beyomin dechola, al eved Adonai, ihi mikkise hakkavod. kema deukemuha
1091: Mare matnitin, kol hanneshamot gezurot mittachat kisse hachavod. veruach deshalta beyome dechol, al eved Adonai, ihi meavda demalka metatron, kalil shit sidre mishna, veihi shesh maalot lakkisse. venefesh deshallit bechol, ihi mikkise din, sandalfon, techelet shebbatztzitztzit, kemaase livnat hassafir. aval beratta demalka. bafesach, ihi nefesh hassichlit, lel shimmurim, matztza shemura, veruach shimmur lokovleh ihi yom tov, veihi yom shabbat, zachor veshamor. begin deihi atztzilut mimmalchut.

Vehachi talmide chachamim, benoy demalka umatronita, itkeriu shabbatot veyamim tovim, velet lon middilhon, delav innun baale melacha, kishar avadin benoy dechulin. agra dilhon bealma den, uvealma deate, leannega lon bechol mine maachol umishte, uleokra lon bilvushin shappirin, kegavvna deshabbat, deittemar beh, kabbedehu bichsut nekiyya. kol ma deavad bar nash leshabbatot veyamim tovim, it lemebad lon.

Uman dimchallel shavat chayyayv sekila. vehachi man deishtammash betaga, chalaf. vehachi hu hammishtammesh bemi sheshshone halachot, dimchallel torateh. vekol shekken hamevazze leh, keillu mevazze shabbatot umoadot. veukemuha mare matnitin, kol hamevazze et hammoadot, keillu kofer baikar.

Uchegavvna dechol mane bet hammikdash veitkeriu kodesh, hachi kol innun dimshamshe talmide chachamim, itkeriu kodesh. vetalmide derav deinnun lokovel evarim degufa, itkeriu kodesh kodashim. veraza demilla ka ramiz behon, (Shemot 26:33-34) vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim. umetatron, at umashshiryayn dilach, tzerichin lekarva lon karbena kodam Adonai bechol lelya.

Asiyya lekabbel aleh ol malchut shamayim, da kabbalat yisurin daaniut letalmid chacham ihu mavt legufa diviran. dimzona deorayyta, ihu mezona denishmeta verucha venafsha sichliyyim, deinnun kohen levi veyisrael. kohen beh 10, chachma vaday. levi, beh Adonai, tevuna. yisrael, beh daat, veda 6. nefesh yetera, Adonai batraa, 248 mitztzevavt ese 371 lo taase. vetora da adam, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19) zot hattora adam. veda kalil shema meforash, yod hei vav hei. hay ihu orayyta mezona leadam, bed anpin dileh. mezona diviran, nahama vechamra uvisra, vechol mine perot, (Kohelet 7:14) ze leummat ze asa haelohim.

Vetztzarich bar nash, lekarba bechol lelya, karban nafsha verucha venishmeta diviran, kodam Adonai. veyitvadde bechamma mine viduyin, veyislak lon bemachashavteh, karbena kodam Adonai. leappaka lon bekriat shema, (belev echad) lekame kudesha berich hu, veyappik rucheh dedafik bearkin delibba. nefesh, yechavvivn bisrefatah, uvishchitatah, uvinchirata, dahavo nechirin kahanayay, hada hu dichtiv umalak et rosho mimul arpo velo yavdil. vehayeynu chenek. utelata mitot illen, havo kemara sumaka, yeroka, uchama. deinnun bakkaved bamara batchol, veinnun kitlat kelippin deegoza.

Vekodem da, yetakken mizbach avanim, vichavvin lemebedah sekila, mimmara chivvavra, deshaltat bechanfe rea, beinnun sirchot deillen beiran tefusin tamman. unechitat eshsha techela, vishetztze lon, vihon chevavn uveiran veofin dachyayn, lekarva laAdonai, ulesharyay shemeh alayyhu. behahu zimna yitkayyem behu, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim. vyhon kesuseya derachiv mareh alayyhu, hada hu dichtiv, (Chavakuk 3:8) ki tirchav al susecha markevotecha yeshua, uvehahu zimna (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai.

Veta chaze ihu shakil lechol mare tora, vehachi tzarich lemehevi shakil garmeh missitra deorayyta, umissitra deevarim degufa, tzarich lemishkal garmeh lechol amme haaretz. kema deukemuha mare matnitin, leolam yire adam atztzemo, keillu kol haolam kullo taluy bo. vichavvin benafsheh uverucheh uvenishmateh, lemebad lon karbenin, im kol bene alma. vekudesha berich hu metztzaref machashava tova lemaase. uveda adam uvehema toshia Adonai. kamu kullehu tanain veamorain legabbeh, veamru kullehu bekala chada, ant hu raya mehemana, deit lach reshu lemebad kol da, deant shakil lechol yisrael, uvegin da shallach lach kudesha berich hu benayyhu. (ad kan raya mehemana)

Tosefta (Vayikra 6:18) zot torat haola. amar ribbi chiyyay, hay kera okimna leh behay gavvna, zot torat: da keneset yisrael. haola da machashava raa, deihi salleka al reuta debar nash, leastaa leh mearcha dikshot. hi haola: hi hi desalleka veasteyay leh lebar nash, bae leokda leh
1092: Benura. begin dela yityeyhiv leh ducheta leastaa, uvegin kach al hammizbeach kol hallayla. man layla. da keneset yisrael, deihi zot leitdakkea bar nash mehahu reuta.

Al mokda, begin denahar di nur ihu atar leokda, lechol innun dela kayyme bekiyyumayyhu, deha alin lon behahu nura dedalik umeabbere shuletanehon mealma. uvegin dela tishlot (sefer acher itzterich) al mokda kol hallayla, veitkafyay vela shalta. (ad kan tosefta)

Ketiv (Melachim 1 19:11) vehinne Adonai over vegomer veruach gedola vechazak vegomer. ruach gedola deamaran, uchetiv lo varuach Adonai. veachar haruach raash dichtiv, (Yechezkel 3:12) vattissaeni ruach vaeshma acharay kol raash gadol. hare raash avatreh deruach. veachar haraash esh, da hu dichtiv (Daniel 7:10) nehar di nur nagid venafek min kodamohi vegomer.

Ribbi yitzchak amar hayeynu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:13) udemut hachayyot marehen kegachale esh boarot kemare hallappidim hi mithallechet ben hachayyot venoga laesh umin haesh yotze varak veachar haesh kol demama dakka. kol da, kol batraa, dehi demama, delet lah milla perata, ella hi demama miggarmah. vechad mitkanneshe alah, hi ishtema bechullehu almin, vechullehu mizdaaze minnah. demama dakka, amay hi dakka. begin (sefer acher deihi) (deatya) zeera mikkolla.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach lo tichbe, da eshsho deyitzchak. dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:7) hinne haesh vehaetzim, vehayeynu esh tamid, dekayyeyma tadir. vehaetzim, illen etzim deavraham, dichtiv uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker.

Tenan, meeshsha deyitzchak nagid umate lehay mizbeach, venafik gumera chad listar mizrach, vegumera chad listar maarav, vegumera chad listar tzafon, vegumera chad listar darom, led zavvyyayn demadbecha, vechahana aschar lah led zavvyyayn.

Bemadbecha (sefer acher bammizrach) it kevesh chad, bedargin yedian. vedarga tattaa, mate venachit lithoma illaa, miggo shit chad. uveshaata deinnun gumerin matu led zavvyyayn, chad zika ittear venachit lehahu tehoma illaa.

Uvehahu atar, it chayyaylin chayyaylin deamre kadosh, bekal rav illaa. umissitra ochora amre kadosh, bekal neimuta illaa. umissitra ochora, chayyaylin ochoranin deamre kadosh. vechen led zavvyayn. shit mea elef ribbevavn chayyaylin bechol zavvyyay ishtechach, vealayyhu chad memana, vechullehu mitlabbeshe efoda, vekayyme lesaddera pulechana demadbecha lokovel tattae.

Baatar ochora mishtakkeche galgalle yamma denahamin, venachtin bedargin yedian, vetamman chayyaylin amrin bekal neimuta, (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. vechullehu meshabbeche beshirata, vela mishtachche bimama uvelelya, vechullehu mesaddere shevacha bekal neimuta.

Baatar ochora, mishtakkeche chayyaylin chayyaylin, kayymin bidchilu bezia beretet, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1) venoga lahem veyira lahem. (vegabbah lahem veyire lahem). vechullehu mistakkele legabbe hahu madbecha dilella.

Uveshaata demate eshsha deyitzchak al gabbe madbecha, kama zikin sallekin venachtin lechol ivar, umitlahatin minnayyhu, kama takkifin mare dechela, gibbarin dealma. veilmale dechahana kaim al madbecha, umesadder ain, la yachil alma lemekam kamayyhu. meillen gumerin vezikin denafkin, mitlahatan gabbehon deinnun chevavn, kema deat amer udemut hachayyot marehem kegachale esh boarot kemare hallappidim.

Missitra dimina deinnun chevavn, ittear rucha chada milleella, nashiv veyativ behahu eshsha, umitlahata umitbassema, velahit, veshachich bezivav yakkira, venahir lechamma chayyaylin dekayymin besitra dimina. missitra dismala, ittear rucha ochora takkifa, matbar tinarin, venashiv (sefer acher vitev) behahu eshsha, veittekaf veitgabbar. keden itlebash minneh hahu rucha demissitra dismala, venahir (sefer acher valehayt) lechamma chayyaylin dekayymin lehahu setar. vechen learba sitrin, led mashiryayn. vechullehu mitbasseman beshaata dechahana salik al madbecha.
Amar ribbi abba teren madbechan innun letatta, uteren leella. chad penimaa decholla,
1093: Demitkarev beh ketoret penimaa, vedakka. kishshura dimhemnuta, vechahana illaa mikkolla, itkeshar (nusach acher aketar) ketorta da, bekishshura dimhemnuta, veda itkere mizbach hazzahav, umehacha itketar veitkeshar kishra dimhemnuta, bechad kishra. vechad madbecha ochora, veikre mizbach hannechoshet, veda hu levar, (ravreva illaa) umichael hassar haggadol, makriv aleh karbena nayycha dekudesha berich hu. uletatta, mizbach hazzahav, umizbach hannechoshet, beda ketoret. uveda chalavin veemurin.

Veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev. vela ketiv shemen vachalavin veemurin yesammach, af al gav deitbasmuta derugeza vedina innun. aval shemen uketoret, chedvavta decholla ihu, vela missitra derugeza vedina. veda madbecha deihu penimaa diktoret (sefer acher deinnun penimaa diktoret) dakka, bedakkuta decholla, bekishshura dimhemnuta, ikre kol demama dakka, uvegin deihu madbecha penimaa, deitkeshar bekishshura dimhemnuta.

Madbecha ochora, ikre mizbeach hachitzon. ufenimaa ikre mizbach Adonai. ochora, ikre mizbach hannechoshet, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 8:64) mizbach hannechoshet asher lifne Adonai katon mehachil vegomer. ribbi yose amar mehacha, (Devarim 33:10) vechalil al mizbechecha, tere. uchetiv al mizbechotay leratzon.

Ribbi abba (acha) amar, ketiv (Shemot 17:15) vayiven moshe mizbeach vegomer, lokovel hahu penimaa banah hay, veal da itkere Adonai nissi. mahu nissi. derashim reshima deat kayyayma kaddisha. divshaata daamalek ata leabera hay reshima kaddisha minayyhu deyisrael, hay mizbach kayyeyma lokovleh lenakma hahu nukema deat kayyayma, veal da itkere (Vayikra 26:25) cherev nokemet nekam berit. veda atkenat lehu leyisrael reshima kaddisha. umoshe bana lokovel hay mizbeach, vekare leh Adonai nissi. veda hu mizbeach penimi, (Melachim 1 19:12) kol demama dakka.

Veal da esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach vegomer, esh deishtechach tedira. umay ihu. eshsha deyitzchak. ucheden, shema da, adonay. vechad yesaddar ala kahana innun ain, itbasma bishma, vekarenan lah bishma derachame, Adonai, vekarenan lah bishma da. ulezimnin kayyeyma kegavvna da, ulezimnin kayyeyma kegavvna da. ribbi shimon amar, tere havo, ufenimaa kayyeyma al hahu dilvar, uminah ittezan, veitkashshera da beda.

(Vayikra 6:13) ze karban aharon. ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Tehillim 145:17) tzaddik Adonai bechol derachav vechasid bechol maasav. tzaddik Adonai bechol derachav, ha tanenan, kama it lon livne nasha leistakkela bikara demarehon, vela yistu mearchayyhu levar. deha bechol yoma veyoma dina tale bealma, begin dealma al dina itbere vekayyeyma.

Veal da, bae bar nash leistammera mechovoy, dela yada zimna dedina sharya aloy. yativ beveteh, dina sharya aloy. nafak mibbeteh levar, dina sharya aloy. vela yada i yetuv leveteh i lav. nafik learcha, al achat kama vechamma, deha keden dina nafka kammeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 85:14) tzedek lefanav yehallech. begin kach, bae leakdema ulemibbae rachame kame malka, begin deyishteziv min dina, beshaata desharya bealma. deha kol yoma veyoma sharya dina bealma, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom.

Hasheta it lememar, ha tanenan, veittearu chavrayyay, el bechol atar chesed hu, kema deat amer (Devarim 10) hael haggadol, veda nehiru dechachma illaa, veat (119 amud bet) amrat veel zoem bechol yom, shavik kera kol illen shemahan, veachid behay, i hachi la kayymin mille. veod, dichtiv, (yeshaya 9) el gibbor, o nokim leh dina, o nokim leh rachame.

Ella hachi shemana, chayyayvayya mehappeche rachame ledina. delet lach bechol innun kitrin illain demalka kaddisha, dela kelilan rachame bedina, vedina berachame. vechayyayvayya, mehappeche rachame ledina.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, shappir behahu dichtiv el gibbor, ella el zoem bechol yom mahu, deha bechol yoma veyoma kayyeyma bedina, ben divne alma zakkain, ben dela zakkain. la hava bideh, atu shailu leh lerabbi shimon. amar lon, vadday el zoem bechol yom, veha ukemuha chavrayyay, lezimnin hu dina, lezimnin hu
1094: Rachame. i zakkain bene alma, ha el kayyeyma, vehu chesed. vei la zakkan, ha el kayyeyma, veikre gibbor, veal da kayyeyma bechol yoma.

Aval milla shappir hu, el bechol atar, nehiru (202) dechachmeta illaa hu, vekayyeyma bekiyyumeh bechol yoma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 52:3) chesed el kol hayyom. veilmale dehay el ittear bealma, la yachil alma lemekam afillu shaata chada, mikkamme dinin takkifin demitarin bealma bechol yoma, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, al tikre behibbaram, ella beavraham, beitaruta deavraham kayyme, vechad ittear avraham bealma, kol innun dinin demishtakkeche bechol yoma veyoma dache lehu levar, vela kayymin kammeh.

Hada hu dichtiv, veel zoem bechol yom, nizam, o zeum bechol yom, la ketiv, ella zoem. bechol yoma veyoma dedina ishtechach, dache lon levar, vekayyeyma hu umevassem alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. veilmale hay, la yachil alma lemekam afilu riga chada. veal da kolla kayymu begineh deavraham.

Vehay dichtiv el gibbor, lav deihu gibbor, ella hay kera remez hu deka ramiz laavahan, uremiza hu deka ramiz limhemnuta illaa kaddisha, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 9:Adonai) pele yoetz el gibbor avi ad sar shalom. pele, da chachmeta illaa, dehi pelia veitkasya mikkolla, kema deat amer (Devarim 17:8) ki yippale mimmecha davar. yoetz, da hu nahar illaa denagid venafik, vela paska, veda yoetz lecholla, veashke lecholla. el da avraham, kema deokimna hael haggadol. gibbor, da yitzchak, dichtiv haggibbor. avi ad, da yaakov, deachid lehay sitra ulehay sitra, vekayyeyma bekiyyuma shelim. sar shalom, da tzaddik, deihu shelama dealma, shelama deveta, shelama dematronita.
Atu ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yehuda, venashsheku yedoy. bachu, veamru zakkaa chulakana, deshailna hay. zakkaa hu dara, deat share begavavyyhu.

Amar ribbi shimon, ketiv. ze karban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu laAdonai. ta chaze, chayyayve alma, garmin leh lekudesha berich hu, leistalleka mikkeneset yisrael. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 16:28) ish tahpuchot yeshallach madon venirgan mafrid alluf. man hu alluf. da kudesha berich hu (deihu allufo shel olam), kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 3:4) alluf neuray atta. veinnun (chayyayve) mafrishin lezot mizze, deihu shelama deveta, veinnun ziuuga chada.

Ata aharon kaddisha uvenoy, veal yedayyhu mitkarvin tarvavyyhu, veizdevavg ze bezot. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh. ze karban aharon uvanav. veinnun mezavvevge lemalka kaddisha illaa bematronita, veal yedayyhu mitbarchan illain vetattain, umishtachchin birchan bechullehu almin, veishtechach kolla chad bela piruda.

Vei tema, amay la ketiv zot karban, lekarva zot leatreh. lav hache, deha kahana meella ka share leayytaa ziuuga lah lichneset yisrael, ad demate lehay ze, leizdavvevga bezot ulekarva lon kachada. uvegin kach kahana ashlim karbena vekariv ziuuga, zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvealma deate.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havo azle meusha litverya, amar ribbi chiyyay, ketiv (Tehillim 132:14) ki vachar Adonai betziyyon vegomer. zot menuchati vegomer, lezimnin karan lehay chavrayyay kullehu dechura, begin deihu (sefer acher detzion ihu) rachame. vehacha kera nukeba kara leh.

1096: Behay yoma mistayyeyme dina. uvegin kach baenan levattesha lon beara, ulesayyma lon dela mishtachchu, dehay yoma ittearuta vesiyyuma hu. veal da ittearuta vesiyyuma hu deavdinan bearve nachal.

Vetanain veamorain, i temrun vechi am haaretz mena yada da. ella vadday am haaretz ihu keshor, o se, o ez, o (par) tor, o yona. ma beiran la yade orayyta, deihi shem Adonai. hachi am haaretz, la yada. ella michael kahana rabba, ihu avid leh ola vekarbena kodam Adonai, veihu mechavvevn bishma meforash, bisliku derucheh, detifuk bellev echad, kegavvna dechad nafik rucha debar nash bechol lelya.

1099: Delet beh chachma, lav ihu chasid. uvegin da ukemuha, velo am haaretz chasid. vei it beh Adonai, chamsha chumashe tora, deityeyhivu missemala, itkere gibbor battora, vire chet. vei ihu bur, ittemar beh, en bur yere chet.

Uman dezache letiferet, deihu 6, veihu chacham mevin battora vire chet, yarit malchuteh, deihu hei, mitztzevat hammelech, i avid pikkude malka. kevan dezache leshem Adonai, zache lishma meforash deitkere adam, veda yod hei vav hei. behahu zimna shallit al gufeh, deihu shuttafu denefesh habbehemit. veruach habbehemit divnefesh habbehemit asiyyayt havele alma, ruach memallela behavele alma (neshama dibba kol hirhurin vamechashebavet dahebaley alma). vetalmid chacham shallit alayyhu.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:26) veyirdu vidgat hayam uveof hashamayim uvabbehema uvechol haaretz. may uvechol haaretz. da gufa, olam katan, vedachalin minneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem. missitra dimina, shallit alayyhu, beh veyirdu, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 72:8) veyyird miyyam ad yam. missitra dismala, dachalin minneh, hada hu dichtiv umoraachem vechittechem. vealeh ittemar, yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto.
Batar deihu tzadik, la yahiv leh sechar mitztzevot, let leh agra bealma da, vela mezona liviran deani chashuv kammet. ihu im shechinta bikviu dilah immah al kolla.

(Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu. hay esh, tzarich leh tamid immah, delet leh keviya, deihu achil kol karbanin ditztzelotin, umillin deorayyta. deihi shechinta ihu parnasa dileh, uvemma. bitztzelotin, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 5) pitchi li. pitchi li, bitztzelota deittemar bah (Tehillim 51:17) adonay sefatay tiftach, deihi achoti rayati, velet rayati ella parnasati, devah metakkenin maachalin dekarbenin demalka benin kadishin, bechamma mine maachalim, benahama deorayyta.
