(ad kan raya mehemana).

Ta chaze, af al gav divine aharon mitu behahoy shaata, yaut hava bechamma gavvnin. chada, dela hava shaata diktoret, deha ketoret la salleka, ella bezimnin yedian, dichtiv (Shemot 30:7) vehiktir alav aharon ketoret sammim babboker babboker. veematay behetivo et hannerot vegomer leishtachcha shemen uketoret kachada. uchetiv uvehaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna vegomer.

Uvezimnin illen itkeriv, vela bezimna ochora, bar bezimna demotana sharya bealma, kema deira dichtiv (Bamidbar 17:11) vayyomer moshe el aharon kach et hammachta veten aleha esh vegomer. uvene aharon la kerivu beshaata deshemen uketoret mishtachche kachada.
Veod dedachaku shaata bechayye daavuhon. veod dela ansivu, vahavu pegimin,

Raya mehemna (pikkude 260) let metztzora ella hahu deitavid bezavuta. dechamesh damim innun dedam nidda misavin, deinnun kullehu dam tame. vaAdonai damin dachyayn. uman deabar alayyhu, keillu abar al eser dibberot, deinnun kelal 613 pikudin.

Veshifcha yitztzer hara ihi malya mumin. uvegin da, (Vayikra 21:18) chol asher bo mum lo yikrav. uvegin da, kahana la hava tzarich lekarva legave man deit beh muma, mikkol mumin dealma. begin dematronita ittemar bah, (Shir HaShirim 4:7) kullach yafa rayati umum en bach. hachi la tzarich lekarva legabbah man deit beh mum, veuf hachi la tzarich lemikrav legabbah zar (Bamidbar 3:10) vehazzar hakkarev yumat vehayeynu mamzir, mum zar. mum nukeba, zar zachar. uvegin da mane. (Vayikra 18:19) veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav veal innun dikrivin lah, ketiv behon vayakrivu lifne Adonai esh zara asher lo tzivva otam vattetztze esh millifne Adonai.
1100: Deman dela ansiv, pagim hu, velav hu keday leishtachcha birchan bealma al yedoy, aloy la sharyayn, kol shekken al yedoy laacherim. veod, deha tenan revvavy chamra havo, uvegin kach, vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam vegomer. deha ketoret chaviv hu mikkolla, vechedvavta deillain vetattain, uchetiv (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev.

Vekarban deatvavn innun, 10 baish, Adonai baishsha, 6 babben chatan, Adonai bakkalla. zakkaa ihu man deakriv atvavn diydod, beh uveitteteh uvivreh uvivratteh, bikdushsha uvivracha binkiu baanava uvevoshet panim bechol midot tavin dichtivin al mare matnitin.

Umitchammemin beeshin kadishin, deish veishsha deinnun esh, ole veyyored, esh kodesh daatztze hamaaracha, deinnun atztze hakkodesh evarin kadishin, veesh shel gavoah nachit, deihu kodesh hakkadashim, uvegin teren eshshin illen amar navi, (Yeshayahu 24:15) baurim kabbedu Adonai. deinnun eshshin dishchinta, devah ketiv (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu.
Veinnun esh illaa kisse rachamim. esh tattaa kisse din. veinnun bina umalchut malchut esh ole. bina esh yored. Adonai, ammuda deemtztzaita, achid betarvavyyhu. bina Yahu Adonai malchut.

Tiferet kad achid lon, sharya aleh chachma, deveh koach ma. ma: ihu yod hei vav hei. koach dileh, yod vav dalet. hei alef. vav alef vav. hei alef. vechullehu 42 atvavn, mishtachchin bebar nash uveitteh uvivnoy, uvegin da let bar nash shelim, ella beven uvat.

Uman delet leh ben deihu 6, istallak 10 mineh. uman delet leh bat, deihi Adonai, istalak Adonai illaa, deihi em, min bat zugeh. deatvavn la sharyayn da bela da. uvegin da, beish veishsha ben uvat, deitavedu kedka yiot, sharya alayyhu Adonai, veitkeriu (sham 14) (sefer acher banim lekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv) (Devarim 14:1) banim atem laydod elohechem. (ad kan raya mehemana).

(Vayikra 7:35) zot mishchat aharon umishchat banav. ribbi yose amar, zot vaday meshichuta deaharon. deha aharon itmeshach, veayyte mimshach revut illaa meella, venagid leh letatta. veal yeda deaharon itmeshach, mimshichata kadisha leitbarcha, veal da zot mishchat aharon umishchat banav vadday.

Ribbi yehuda patach, (Melachim 2 4:2) vayomer eleha elisha ma eese lach hagidi li ma yesh lach babbayit. mehacha olifna, delet birchata sharya befatora rekanya, veal milla rekanit. vattomer en leshifchatcha kol babbayit ki im asuch shamen. amar lah, vday siyyua denissa hu, deha vadday beatreh hu, umittamman birchan nafkin vesharyayn. ma ketiv hem maggishim eleha vehi motzaket. vehi motzaket setam.

Ribbi yose amar, vayyaamod hashshamen, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:1) bekeren ben shamen. uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 1:3) shemen turak shemecha, leachazaa deha mehay shemen, negidin birchan al yeda dechahana, vechahana nagid lehu letatta, veamshach (sefer acher veitmeshach) lehay zot, hada hu dichtiv zot mishchat aharon umishchat banav, uchetiv (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh, veha ittemar.

(Vayikra 8:2) kach et aharon veet banav itto veet habbegadim. ribbi chiyyay patach (Tehillim 36:10) ki immecha mekor chayyim beorcha nire or. ki immecha mekor chayyim, da shemen illaa, denagid vela pasik lealmin, desharya bego chachma illaa decholla, hada hu dichtiv ki immecha, immecha sharya, vela mitparsha minach lealmin, bachavivuta decholla. mekor chayim, begin dehi mekora umabbua dechayyim, leappaka chayyim leilana illaa, ulaadlaka butzinin. veal da hahu ilana ikre etz chayyim, ilana denatia veishtarsha begin hahu mekora dechayyim.
Veal da beorcha nire or. beorcha: da or deganiz letzaddikayyay lezimna deate, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. umehahu nehiru zeminin yisrael leanhara
1101: Davar acher ki immecha mekor chayyim vegomer, da kudesha berich hu, deihu ilana illaa bimtziut ginta, deachid lechol sitrin. may tama. begin deachid beh hahu (nusach acher behahu) mekor chayyim, veattar leh beitrin illain sacharaneh deginta. keimma dimattera livrah al kolla, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon vegomer. uvegin kach ki immecha mekor chayyim, veal da beorcha nire or.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, ki immecha mekor chayyim, da kohen gadol leella, lokovleh kohen gadol letatta. begin kach, angid kahana meshach revut illaa kaddisha letatta, veadlik butzinin leella. dechohen gadol shelim bishlimu dez yomin illain, uleitattera al kolla.

Lokovel da 7 yeme milluim, lechahana diltatta, leishtakkecha kolla kegavvna dilella. veal da yeme milluim ikrun: yome ashlemuta. begin deyishtelim kahana bishar yomin ochoranin, leashlema 7 kachada. veillen yeme milluim ikrun, begin deitachadan shear ochoranin beh. may ka mayyre. dechad kahana ittear, kol shear ochoranin mitarin immeh.

Uvegin kach ketiv umippetach ohel moed vegomer, ad yom melot vegomer. 7 yomin vadday, keden itattar kahana letatta becholla, kegavvna dilella. begin divshaata dechahana diltatta ittear, kolla yittearun al yedeh leella, veyishtachchun birchan leella vetatta.

Ribbi abba amar, may shena demashach moshe leaharon. ella, begin deihu bera dehahu (sefer acher achid behahu) atar mekora dechayye. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 63:12) molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto. umoshe shimmesh kol innun 7 yeme milluin, leashraa kolla immeh deaharon.

Ribbi chizkiyya hava yativ kame deribbi elazar, amar leh, kama nehorin itberiu ad la ivre alma. amar leh 7. veillen innun: or tora. or gehinnam. or gan eden. or kisse hakkavod. or bet hammikdash. or teshuva. oro shel mashiach. veillen itberiu ad la itbere alma. 7 nehorin butzinin itachadu beh beaharon, vehu adlik butzinin meella letatta.
Ribbi elazar patach (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar. ha tanenan, hakkol haya min heafar, afillu galgal chamma. man heafar. hahu desharya techot kurese yekara kaddisha.

Besifra deve rav yesa sava, hakkol haya min heafar, atar dechanish lecholla, melammed, denafku shevilin lehay sitra ulehay sitra, veitkenashu leanhara, keafra da dezarkin lah lechol ivar. veal da hakkol haya min heafar, vehakkol shav el heafar vadday.

Ella min heafar, deve makdesha kaddisha. vehay afar meafra illaa, kema deat amer (Iyov 28:6) veafrot zahav lo. kema deishtechach ovada letatta, hachi name hu leella kegavvna da. veokimna afar, afar deve makdesha. dealma da baAdonai itbere. veal da, afillu galgal chamma. kema deat amer, ele toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, baAdonai beraam. uvegine kach, hakkol haya min heafar. man afar. hahu deshari techot kurese yekara kaddisha.

Ketiv (Shir HaShirim 4:7) kullach yafa rayati umum en bach. kullach yafa rayati, da keneset yisrael. umum en bach, ellu sanhedrin deinnun lokovel shivin uteren shemahan. 70 nefesh denachtu im yaakov, vekudesha berich hu al kolla. veal da en bodkin min hasanhedrin ulemala tenan.

Ketiv (Shemot 19:6) veatem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh. man mamlechet kohanim. kema deat amer, zot mishchat aharon umishchat banav, dechad itbarcha keneset yisrael al yeda dechahane, keden itkere al shemehon, hada hu dichtiv mamlechet kohanim.

Rabbi shimon amar, ta chaze, malchut kohanim la ikre, ella mamlechet, deamlechu lah kahane, veavdu lah (gabeyretaa) gevureta al kolla. aval malchut kohanim la ikre, deha min hashshamayim ikre malchut, malchut shamayim vadday. vehacha mamlechet, kema deat amer dechahane amlechu lah, umechabberan lah bemalka, ucheden hi mamlechet, al kol ginze malka. mamlechet al kol zayne malka.
1102: Mamlechet beillae vetattae. mamlechet al kol alma.
Ribbi yose amar, ketiv (Amos 9:6) vaaguddato al eretz yesadah. vaaguddato: kad izdevavg malka lokovlah, bechol innun itrin kadishin, bichnufeya chad, keden vaaguddato ketiv.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, vaaguddato: kema deat amer, (Shemot 12:22) ulekachtem aguddat ezov. may ka mayyre. dechad mitchabberan kachada, veitbarcha minnayyhu, keden shalta al kolla, venahara leella vetatta. vecholla beshaata dechahana palach pulechana, veakriv karbena, veaktar ketoret, umechavvivn millin lekarva kolla kachada. keden ketiv, vaaguddato al eretz yesadah.

Ribbi yose amar, kad natal aharon kolla natlin immeh, ad deitbarcha keneset yisrael, veitbarchan illae vetattae. keden ketiv, (Tehillim 135:21) baruch Adonai mitziyyon shochen yerushalam haleluyah. (Tehillim 72:19) uvaruch shem kevodo leolam veyimmale chevodo et kol haaretz amen veamen.

Ribbi elazar hava azil mikkappotkayya lelud, vahavu immeh ribbi yesa veribbi chizkiyya. patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Yeshayahu 51:16) vaasim devaray beficha uvetzel yadi kissiticha vegomer. tanenan, kol bar nash deishtaddal bemille deorayyta, vesifvavteh merachshan orayyta, kudesha berich hu chappeya aleh, ushechinta parsa aleh gadfaha, hada hu dichtiv vaasim devaray beficha uvetzel yadi kissiticha. velo od, ella dehu mekayyem alma, vekudesha berich hu chadde immeh, keillu hahu yoma nata shemaya veara. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 51:16) lintoa shamayim velisod aretz velemor letziyyon ammi atta.

Mikkan olifna, deyisrael ikrun bishma detziyyon, dichtiv velemor letziyyon ammi atta, vachamena dichneset yisrael ikre bishma detziyyon, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:27) tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka.

Tu patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 8:16) tzor teuda chatom tora belimmuday. tzor teuda. da sahaduta dedavid, dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:12) veedoti zo alammedem. tzor: hi kishshura, keman dekatar ketura baatar chad. chatom tora belimmuday. chatom tora: chatima deorayyta, vechol negidu urevu denagid milleella, bean (nusach acher ben) chatima dileh. belimmuday. begin detamman itkenash revu umishcha, ben teren kayaymin, detamman sharyayn, atar kenishu dechol revut umeshach denagid milleella, leashdaa leh befuma deamma, ulearka leh behay teuda. ucheden itkeshar kolla kishra chad mehemana.

Ta chaze, ma ben innun demishtaddele beorayyta, linvie mehemne. innun demishtaddele beorayyta, adife minnevie bechol zimna. may taama. deinnun kayyme bedarga illaa, yattir minnevie, innun demishtaddele beorayyta kayyme leella, beatra deikre tora, (nusach acher tiferet) dehu kiuma dechol mehemnuta. unevie kayyme letatta, baatar deikrun netzach vehod. veal da (ikrun), innun demishtaddele beorayyta, adife minnevie, veillain minnehon yattir. deillen kayymin leella, veillen kayymin letatta. innun deamre millin beruach hakkodesh, kayyme letatta mekullehu. (veal da)

Zakkain innun demishtaddele beorayyta, deinnun bedarga illaa yattir al kolla. (veal da) man delae beorayyta, la itzterich la lekarbenin, vela leillavavn. deha orayyta adif mikkolla, vekishshura dimhemnuta decholla. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 3:17) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom. uchetiv, (Tehillim 119:165) shalom rav leohave toratecha veen lamo michshol.

Ad dahavo azle, ashkachu chad gavra dehava ate, veg anpe hadas bideh, kerivu gabbeh, amru leh lamma lach hay. amar leravvcha ovda. amar ribbi elazar shappir kaamrat. aval 3 illen lamma. amar leh, chad leavraham. chad leyitzchak, vechad leyaakov. vekashirna lehu kachada, vearachna behu. begin dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:3) lereach shemanecha tovim shemen turak shemecha. begin divhay recha, itkeyyaym chulesha denafsha, uvehemnuta da itkayyeyma, veitnegidu birchan meella vetatta. amar ribbi elazar zakkaa chulakehon
1103: Ta chaze, let alma (nusach acher nafsha) mitkayyeyma, ella al recha, umerecha da ishtemoda recha ochora. deha beshaata denafik shabbeta, (nitparda hachavila) vesalleka nafsha yetera, veishtaarun nafsha verucha mitparshan atzivin, ata recha da, umitkarvan da beda vechaddan.

Veal da, bae rucha batar rucha, lekabbela recha, kevan deitkabbal recha mitkarvan kachada vechaddan. ke hay gavvna recha dekurebna, berecha (da) mitkarvin kolla kachada, umitlahatan butzine vechaddan.

Ta chaze, tere butzine, chad leella vechad letatta, i lahit bar nash hay butzina diltatta, vechave lah (sefer acher lehahu dilella), hahu tenana desalik (nusach acher mibbutzina tattaa), lahit hahu butzina illaa. kach tenana dekarbenin, hay tenana desalik, lahit butzine illae, umitlahatan bechad, umitkarvin kullehu kachada, berecha da. uvegin kach, reach nichoach laAdonai, (ishsha) veha ukemuha.

Veal da, recha dekarbena, kiyyuma decholla, vekiyyuma dealma. vekarbena al yeda dechahana, demikrav kolla. uvegin kach, shiva yome ashlemuta, ishtelimu beh, begin deyitbarchun kullehu befulechaneh, veyishtechachu chedvavn uvirkan leella vetatta.

Ketiv (Yeshayahu 25:1) Adonai elohay atta aromimcha vegomer, hay kera ukemuha, Adonai elohay atta. devae bar nash leodaa lishma kaddisha, uleshabbecha leh al kolla. uman atar shevacha dileh, kema deukemuha. vehacha meamika decholla, dichtiv ki asita pele. pele: kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 9:Adonai) vayyikra shemo pele, veha ittemar. etzot merachok, etzot: kema deat amer, yoetz. merachok: dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li. uchetiv, (Mishlei 31:14) mimmerchak tavi lachmah.

Emuna omen, kema deat amer, (Devarim 32:4) el emuna veen avl. veukemuha emuna ballayla, kema deat amer (Tehillim 92:3) veemunatecha ballelot. uchetiv (Eicha 3:23) chadashim labbekarim rabba emunatecha, vezammin kudesha berich hu ledakkea lon leyisrael mechovehon, kema dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem mikkol tumotechem umikkol gillulechem ataher etchem. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
1104: Leitchabbera beorayyta, hare hi peticha lekabbela leh, uleishtattefa bahadeh. uveshaata debar nash, satim enoy minnah, veyehach learcha ochora, hare hi setima, missitra ochora. kema deat amer, im yom taazveni yomayim eezvekka. vela yishkach pitcha, ad deyetuv leitchabbar bah beorayyta anpin beanpin, vela yitneshe minnah. veal da orayyta patchat kame bene nasha veachreza vekare lehon (Mishlei 8:4) alechem ishim ekra vegomer uchetiv (Mishlei 1:21) berosh homiyyot tikra befitche shearim bair amareha tomer.
Ribbi yehuda amar, 2 teren gagin, vechad deachid lon. may ka mayyre. ella chad lishshemayya vechad leara, vekudesha berich hu achid vekabbil lon.

Ribbi elazar amar, 3 nehorin (tzedadim illen) innun illain kaddishin, daachidan kachada, veinnun kelala deorayyta, veillen patchin pitcha lecholla. patchin pitcha limhemnuta, veillen beta decholla. veal da bayit ikru, deillen innun beta. uvegin kach sheruta deorayyta 2. deha hi orayyta (sefer acher aviha have asvavta) havi veasvavta dealma.

Uvegin kach, man deishtaddal beorayyta, keillu ishtaddal beh bishma kaddisha. veha ittemar, deorayyta kolla, chad shema kaddisha illaa ihi. uvegin deihi shema kaddisha, patcha bevet, deihi kelala dishma kaddisha, bitlat kishre mehemnuta.

Ta chaze, kol innun demishtaddele beorayyta, mitdabbekin beh bekudesha berich hu, umitattere beitre deorayyta, veitrechimu leella vetatta, vekudesha berich hu oshit lon yemineh (sefer acher vekudesha berich hu areshaym lon) kol shekken innun demishtaddele beorayyta name belelya. veha ukemuha, deinnun mishtattefe bishchinta (nusach acher bichneset yisrael) veitchabbaru kachada. vechad ate tzafra, kudesha berich hu meatter lehu, bechad chuta dechesed, leishtemoda ben illain vetattain.

Vechol innun kochve tzafra, beshaata dichneset yisrael, vechol innun delaan beorayyta, atan leitchazaa kame malka, kullehu mezammere kachada, hada hu dichtiv beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kol bene elohim. may vayyariu. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 24:19) roa hitroaa haaretz. deinnun dinin mittabberin, veattebaru kullehu mikkamme boker, kad ittear boker bealma, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 24) vayyashkem avraham babboker. veal da vayyariu kol bene elohim.

Ribbi elazar hava azil beorcha, ashkacheh leribbi pinchas ben yair dehava ate, gaa chamareh. amar ribbi pinchas, vadday betakula (nusach acher bekala) dechedvevta dachamara, chamena (chamit) anpin chadtin yishtakkechun hacha, kevan denafak mibbatar anpoy detura, chama leh leribbi elazar dehava ate, amar vadday takula (nusach acher kala) dechedvevta ishtelim. nachat ribbi elazar legabbeh, venashik leh, amar leh i tufesa dearcha, chad legabbach, nezil venitchabber kachada. vei lav tol archach vezil. amar leh, vadday lokovlach azilna, kevan deashkachna lach, ezil avatrach venitchabbar kachada.

Patach ribbi pinchas veamar, (Tehillim 128:5) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv vegomer. yevarechcha Adonai mitziyyon, may tama mitztziyyon. begin deha mitamman sharan birchan leishtattefa (sefer acher leishtakkecha). hada hu dichtiv ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha chayyim ad haolam. uvegin kach yevarechcha Adonai mitziyyon deha mittamman nafke birchan lecholla. uree betuv yerushalam, divgine tziyyon yerushalam itbarcha, dechevan detziyyon itmele birchan, keden yerushalam itbarcha, veishtechachu bah rachamim. vechad yerushalam itbarcha, kol amma itbarcha.

Kol yeme chayyecha, dela yitchaze keshet beyomach, kema leavuch. veal da uree betuv yerushalam kol yeme chayyecha. uree vanim levanecha, dachale chattaa, chasidin, kaddishin, keden shalom al yisrael. may shalom al yisrael. ella, keman deamar shelama al resheh demalka, dela yechsar kolla. kach shalom al yisrael, bezimna detzaddikayyay yishtakkechun bealma.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Mishlei 17:6) ateret zekenim bene vanim vetiferet banim avotam. banim ha okimna. bene vanim, illen (35 amud alef) shear kitre malka, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 54:13) vechol banayich limmude Adonai. uchetiv (Eicha 4:2) bene tziyyon hayekarim, kema deat amer vetiferet banim avotam, la mitatteran benin ella baavahan. mikkan olifna, divnin la mitattere, vela mishtakyayn mishshakyu denachala, ella bezimna daavahan mitatteran umitbarchan, hada hu dichtiv
1105: Ad dahavo azle, mata iddan tzelota, nachtu vetzallu. ad dahavo metzale, kaftar chad chivya beragloy dechamara, deribbi pinchas. kista (sefer acher kapetaa) vegaa tere zimne. batar desiyyeymu tzelota, amar ribbi pinchas, vadday tzaara hu livira dili, deha yoma da akdimna, vahavina marchish beorayyta, veabar li baatar delichlucha sharya, vehasheta metzaare lah. kamu vechamu chad chivya katir aragleh, amar ribbi pinchas, chivya chivya, zil veatchar (sefer acher vaasater) kuterach, bekitfura dechura. addehachi itneshar chivya, venafal kafsire kafsire.

Amar ribbi elazar, uma kol kach medakdek kudesha berich hu betzaddikayyay. amar leh, vadday kudesha berich hu medakdek behu betzaddikayyay, venatir lon, uvaa leosfa lon kedushsha al kedushshatayyhu vehasheta hay chamara, al dela natar kedushshata dili itztaar. veda chivya shelicha haveya, vechamma sheluchin it leh lekudesha berich hu uvechullehu avid shelichuteh, vaafillu bechayot bara. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:22) veshalachti bachem et chayyat hassade veshikkela etchem. vaafillu beyad goy, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 28:49) yishsho Adonai alecha goy merachok miktze haaretz.

Amar ribbi elazar, uvida deyisrael avid shelichuta. amar leh, in. kegon rasha bida detzaddik. aval rasha bida deyisrael rasha ochora, la avid beh shelichuta, ella bezimna deihu la mechavvevn beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 21:13) vaasher lo tzada vehaelohim inna leyado. vaasher lo tzada dayyka, dela lekatala leh. da, vehaelohim inna leyado, begin leanesha letarvavyyeyhu.
Amar ribbi elazar, hechi avid kudesha berich hu shelichuta bida dehane, uvida degoy. amar leh veavuch la kaamar lach. amar leh ad la shailna.

Patach veamar, (Iyov 34:29) vehu yashkit umi yarshia vegomer. vehu yashkit, bezimna dekudesha berich hu yahiv shekitu veshalva lebar nash, man hu rashshay leavasha leh, ulemebad leh kategorya. veyaster panim umi yeshurennu. uvezimna deihu astir eneh milleashgecha aleh, man hu deyishgach aleh, lenatra leh, ulemebad leh netiru. veorchoy dekudesha berich hu beda, al goy, veal adam yachad. ben lealma kolla, ben leamma chad, ben lechad bilchodoy.

Ta chaze, bezimna divne nasha mitkashsheran ovadin letatta, ittear legabbayyhu leella yemina dekudesha berich hu. keden mitarin kama rechimin, kama neture alma, kama neture devar nash, mimina umissemala. ucheden itkafya semala, vela yachla leshalletaa. uvezimna divne enasha la mitkashsheran ovadin letatta, semala ittear, vechol innun deatu missitra dismala, kullehu ittearu, vechullehu itavidu sheluchin leavasha legabbayyhu divne nasha. deha innun deavru al pitgame orayyta, kullehu reshimin beanpayyhu, veishtemodan legabbe innun demitteare missitra dismala.

Uvegin kach, chevavta veovde avoda zara, vechol innun deatu missitra dismala, kullehu ikrun (nusach acher inun) sheluchin, legabbe innun reshimin demitteare lehu. veyisrael, af al gav dela mechashran ovadin, kullehu min sitra dimina ka atyayn. uvegin deitkafyay yemina beovadayyhu, shalta alayyhu semala, vechol innun deatu missitra dismala, veal da, shelichuta bida dechevavta vegoy, vechol dedame lon, deinnun missitra dismala, vela bida deyisrael, deaf al gav dechayyayva ihu, missitra dimina ka ate.

Veyisrael chayyayva, denafal bida deyisrael chayyayva ochora, bezimna dela itkavvavn beh, begin deyitanshu tarvavyyhu, vikabbelun onsha ledakkea lon. amar ribbi elazar, menalan. amar leh innun bimina. vela itdevaku bismala, vela itarvu bahadah lealmin, veal da, lezimna ochora itavru.

Amar ribbi elazar, mena lan. amar leh, ta chaze min (Shoftim 20) pillegesh baggiva, deaf al gav dechayyayve ninhu, la baa kudesha berich hu deyitarun gabbayyhu chayyayve yisrael ochoranin. veal da mitu (miyyisrael) kol innun zimnin demitu. ad dechullehu chayyayvin deitaru legabbayyhu, mitu veitavidu, veishtaaru innun
1106: Zakkain yattir, deyaavdun milla beorach keshot. veaf al gav dezakkain innun, la ityeyhiv milla, ella leinnun deityeyhiv. kad shekilan almin kachada, alma tattaa kegavvna dealma illaa, vehahu zimna, la ishtechachu almin shekilan kachada.

Veal da, chayyayvin deyisrael legabbayyhu dechayyayvin ochoranin, lav innun sheluche malka, deha la atyayn missitra dismala. metal livne nasha dechavu lemalka, ittear santira legabbayyhu, letafsa lon, uleanesha lon, leinnun dechavu lemalka. kam chakkim chad minnayyhu, veitarav bahade bene santira, zakaf santira enoy vechama leh. amar leh man yahavach legabban, velav ant meinnun dechavu lemalka, ha ant itannash bekadmita, shekilu leh vekatluhu.

Kach yisrael missitra dimina ka atyayn, vela itdavaku bismala, vela itarvu bahadah lealmin. vechad innun garmin bechovayyhu, deitkafya yemina, veittear semala vechol innun deatu missitreh, i chad miyisrael kam leitarva bahadayyhu, ishtemodan beh, amre leh lav ant meinnun deka atyayn missitra dimina, deitkafya mechovayyhu, velav ant meinnun dechavu lemalka man yahavach legabban. ishtechach deihu itannash bekadmita. ushelomo malka tzavavch lokovlayyhu, veamar (Kohelet 8:9) et asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo. lera lo vadday, begin delav shelicha demalka ihu, vela ate mehahu sitra.

Amar ribbi elazar vday hachi hu, deha tanenan, deit yemina veit semala, rachame vedina, yisrael (limina), veovde avoda zara lismala. yisrael af al gav dechayyayve ninhu, veitkafyayn, innun bimina, vela itdabbekan bismala, vela itarvun bahadah lealmin. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni. dechad istallak yemina yisrael deitdabbekun bahadeh, yistallekun veyitatterun beh. keden itkafya semala, vechol innun deatu missitreh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar vayhi bayom hashshemini kara vegomer. vayhi bayom hashshemini, may yom hashshemini. ella ketiv umippetach ohel moed vegomer, ki shivat yamim yemalle et yedchem. ki shivat, beshivat yamim mibbae leh, o shiva yamim yemalle et yedchem, may ki shivat yamim yemalle.

Ella, zakkain innun kahane, demitattere beitroy demalka kaddisha, umeshichin bimshach revut kaddisha, begin deittear mishcha (achara) illaa, demashke lechol shiva, veitmashshechan mehahu revut kaddisha, veitdelaku minneh kol innun shiva butzinin, vehay meshach revut hu kelala dechol shiva, vechullehu beh itkelilu.

Vetanenan shita innun, vechullehu itkelilan behay, veda hu kelala dechullehu, uvegin kach shivat yamim yemalle, deha behay talyayn. veal da, ikre keneset yisrael, bat sheva. may ihi bat sheva. deihi kelila mishshita ochoranin.

Kevan dehay shiva, ashlim lehu lechahane, veattar lon, umashach lon becholla, kad matu likkeneset yisrael deihi teminaa, itpekad aharon lekarva egel, begin deihu bereh defara, lechappara al hahu chova deegel ochora daavad aharon, vechav legabbe para, deihi teminaa, shelimu dememune (sefer acher daamavenay) yisrael. veishtechach kahana shelim becholla, bitmanya mine levushin dikar, shelim bechol kitrin, shelim leella, shelim letatta.

Uvecholla, bae leachazaa ovada. veal da itavid beh beaharon ovada letatta, begin deyittear hachi leella, veyishtekach kolla begavvna chad, ucheden itbarchan almin kullehu, umishtachchin birchan al yeda dechahana. vehacha ishtelim kahana becholla kadka chaze.

Egel lamma. dichtiv egel ben bakar lechattat, begin hahu chattat, daavad bekadmita. veayil leola, may tama ayil. begin ayil deyitzchak, dahava ola temima, vehay itchaze lekarva, leashlema kolla. vehay atar, missitra deyitzchak ishteav. vehay ayil begin ayil deyitzchak mitkarva ola, (begin deihi ola) deha ola leella salleka, uvegin leattera lah bishlemuta. egel veayil: egel beginah, kidkaamran. ayil, leashlema
1107: Veyisrael dechavu immeh dechahana behay, makrivin kegavvna da, dichtiv veshor veayil lishlamim lizboach lifne Adonai. shor, al ma dechavu. veayil leashlema lehay atar bishlimu deyitzchak.

May shena bechahana dichtiv beh egel lechattat, vela ketiv beyisrael shor lechattat. ella, yisrael ha kabbilu onsha bekadmita, uvegin dekabbilu onsha bechama atar, al da kudesha berich hu la baa leadkera lon chovayyhu kidkadmeta, veal da la ketiv hacha lechattat, ella lishlamim, begin leachazaa shelama, deha kudesha berich hu bishlama behu beyisrael al da.

Aval aharon, deha la kabbil onsha mitztzelota demoshe, dichtiv, (Devarim 9:20) uveaharon hitannaf Adonai vegomer. uchetiv vaetpallel gam bead aharon baet hahi, vead kean chova hava tale, ketiv veegel ben bakar lechattat, lechattat vadday, (veayil leola) begin diychapper choveh, veyitdakke veyishtelim becholla.

Uvehahu yoma ishtelimu illain vetattain. veishtechach shelama becholla, bechedvavta dilella vetatta veilmale deishtechach irbuveya divne aharon behahu yoma, min yoma deistalaku yisrael min yamma, la ishtechach chedvavta deilae vetattae kehahu yoma. behahu yoma itabbar hahu chova min alma, veishtechachu kahana veyisrael mitdakkean minneh. (kol) hahu yoma, itavaru kol innun mekatregin dilella, vahavu azlin veshatan besacharanayyhu deyisrael, vela ishtechachu behahu idana.

Ad degarim shaata, vekamu nadav vaavihu veikkevu (sefer acher veirbevo) chedvavta decholla. veishtechach rugeza bealma, hada hu dichtiv, vayyera chevod Adonai el kol haam, miyad vayyikchu shene vene aharon nadav vaavihu ish machtato vegomer.

Tenan, behahu yoma chedvavta dekneset yisrael havavt, leitkattera bekitura dimhemnuta bechullehu kishrin kaddishin. deha ketoret kashir kolla kachada, uvegin kach ikre ketoret. veinnun atu, ukeshiru kol innun ochoranin kachada, vesharu lah levar, dela kashru lah bahadayyhu, ukeshiru milla ochora. uvegin kach, azhar lon lechahane levatar, dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh.

Uvechamma gavvnin irbevu chedvavta dechneset yisrael. chad dela itnesivu, vela itchazyayn lekarva, uleitbarcha almin al yedayyhu. vechad dela hava shaata kedka yeot. vechad dedachaku shaata. vechad, deha mikkadmat dena, nafak nimusa dilhon, vayyakrivu lifne Adonai esh zara vegomer. vadday milla ochora itkeshsharu bekishshura da, vesharu lechneset yisrael levar. amar leh ribbi pinchas, la tema deinnun sharu lah levar, ella keneset yisrael la itkashshera al yedayyhu. deha bechol atar dela ishtechach dechar venukeba, keneset yisrael la sharya benayyhu kelal. begin kach azhar lechahane, dichtiv bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh, deyishtechach dechar venukeba. veal da la yiul kahana lekudesha, ad deyitnesiv. begin deyishtattaf bekishshura dekneset yisrael. deman dela insiv, share lah likkeneset yisrael levar, vehi la ishtattefa bahadeh, veal da ishtechach irbuveya behahu yoma legabbayyhu. (Vayikra 9:1) vayhi bayom hashshemini, ribbi yose patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:2) keshoshanna ben hachochim ken rayati ben habbanot. keshoshanna ben hachochim, da keneset yisrael, veha ukemuha dekudesha berich hu meshabbach lah lichneset yisrael, vachavivuta dekudesha berich hu lokovlaha, leitdabbeka bah.

Veal da, man deinsiv, bae leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu, uleshabbecha lah lechneset yisrael, deha tanenan becholla bae leachazaa ovada, kema deihu bar nash mitdevak bevat zugeh, vachavivuta dileh lokovlah, kad ate lemiflach kame malka kaddisha, hu ittear ziuuga ochora, deha kudesha berich hu chavivuta dileh leitdabbeka bikkeneset yisrael, uman deitar milla, kudesha berich hu mevarech leh, ukkeneset yisrael mevarcha leh, veha ittemar.

Veal da shevacha dekudesha berich hu dimshabbach lah likkeneset yisrael, keshoshanna deihi ben hachochim, deihi mealleya vesalleka al kolla. kach keneset yisrael ben shear uchelusin, begin dehi salleka
1108: Umitattera al kolla. veda shoshana ben hachochim, veetrog ben hachochim, leachazaa shevacha dekneset yisrael, al kolla.

Ta chaze, keneset yisrael mitbarcha al yede dechahana, veyisrael mitbarchan al yede dechahana. vechahana mitbarcha al yede dechahana illaa, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 6:27) vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem.

Ketiv (Tehillim 25:6) zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meolam hemma. zechor rachamecha, da yaakov. vachasadecha, da avraham. ki meolam hemma, umeolam natal lon kudesha berich hu, vesalik lon leella, vaavad minnayyhu reticha kaddisha, leaggana al alma. uvegin dahavo meolam, hu dechir lehon leaggana ulerachama al alma. kegavvna da. natil kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay min alma, vesalik lon leella, leaggana al alma.

Vei tema yitzchak amay la adkar hacha. ella ishtear leitpara meinnun deakin livnoy, hada hu dichtiv (tehillim 89) orra et gevurattecha. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kagibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina vegomer, veda hu yitzchak, deistallak mehacha. ribbi chiyyay amar, zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha, illen innun yaakov veavraham, devaenan lehon leaggana alan. aval yitzchak, lemebad keravin kayyeyma, uvegine kach la baenan leh legabbayyhu.

Davar acher ki meolam hemma, dechad bara kudesha berich hu alma, natal yitzchak uvara beh alma. chama dela yachil lemekam bilchodoy, natal avraham vekiyyem beh alma. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, al tikre behibbaram, ella beavraham. chama devayayn kiyyuma yattir, natal leyaakov, veshataf leh beyitzchak, vekiyyem alma. hada hu dichtiv beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. veal da, beavraham veyaakov itkayyaym alma. uvegin kach ki meolam hemma.

Ribbi yehuda patach, vayhi bayyom hashshemini, levatar deishtelim aharon, beinnun 7 yomin, veitattar behu, (behahu meshach rabbot kaddisha illaa) yoma teminaa baya leishtallema min shiva, deashlamuta al yede dechahana, veal da pulechana bitminaa, leitattera min shiva. uleittakkena kahana al hahu (chova) dechav (sefer acher dekabbil) bekadmita.

Hada hu dichtiv, vayyomer el aharon kach lecha egel, ha ukemuha egel vday, lechappera al hahu egel, dichtiv (Shemot 32:4) vayyaasehu egel massecha. ben bakar, may tama ben bakar, vela ben para. ella ihu bae leittakna legabbe para, la itchaze lekarva minnah legabbah. man deshadar doron lemalka, chamitun denasiv mibbe malka, veyahiv lemalka, ella dorona leshaddera lemalka, mibbe ochora itzterich, vela mibbe malka. ribbi yose amar, middideh ledideh la itchaze. amar ribbi yehuda begin kach ben bakar vadday vela ben para.

Lechattat: ledakkea al hahu chova dechav beh. veayil leola temimim. temimim, tamim mibbae leh. i tema deal ayil veegel kaamar, lav hache. deha tarvavyyhu la sallekin leola, deha ketiv leola temimim, veeggel lechattat salleka, mahu temimim, uchetiv ayil.

Ella elo deyitzchak, lekarva legabbe para, deidkar tere zimne bikra, chad dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:13) vayyissa avraham et enav vayyar vehinne ayil, ha chad, vechad vayyelech avraham vayyikkach et haayil, ha tere, vayyaalehu leola. veal da ayil leola temimim, tere ayil, deihu tere. veal da (vaychi 241 amud alef) gevurot tanenan, uminnayyhu mitparshin lechamma ochoranin.

(Vayikra 9:3) veel bene yisrael tedabber lemor kechu seir izzim lechattat, egel lechattat mibbae leh, kegavvna dechahana. ella yisrael ha kabbilu onsha, veal da la ketiv behu egel lechattat, ella egel leola. may tama. dechol innun dechavu beh, kabbilu onsha, ben bemillula, ben beovada, ben befulechana, vaafillu innun dela avdu midi, ella disliku leh biruta delibbayyhu lemiflach leh, itanashu, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 32) vayyashk et bene yisrael. aval kol innun disliku leh biruta dela lemiflach leh, ella disliku gavvna diruta mineh, hacha itdakkan, umekarvin leh
1109: Aval kechu seir izzim lechattat, amay. ella begin dahavo mekarvin bekadmita lasseirim, deshaltin al ture ramae. veda hu lechattat, uvayayn leitdakkea mehahu chova, velo od ella lechadtute desihara itzterich.

(Vayikra 9:4) veshor veayil lishlamim. shor vela par, begin deshor shelim ihu, leachazaa shelama, hada hu dichtiv lishlamim. ribbi yose amar, shor veayil missitra dismala ka atyayn. shor missitra dismala, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene shor mehassemol. ayil, begin elo deyitzchak. vesallekin lishlamim, leashlema lon likkeneset yisrael veal da shor vaayil lishlamim.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kolla begin dechneset yisrael mitattera umitbarcha al yeda dechahana, beashlemuta. vehay yoma chedvavta decholla hava, chedvavta dechneset yisrael bekudesha berich hu, chedvavta deillain vetattain. uchemma deishtelim kahana letatta, kivyachol ishtelim kahana leella, bar nadav vaavihu deitaru irbuveya ben matronita umalka. uvegin kach vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam vegomer.

(Chaser) (Vayikra 10:12) vayyomer moshe el elazar veel itamar rashechem al tifrau vegomer, ki shemen mishchat Adonai alechem. ribbi abba amar, ha tanenan beovadin diltatta, ittearun ovadin leella, veovada diltatta bae leitchazaa kegavvna deovada dilella.

Ta chaze, kol chedvavta dilella, talya behahu shamna kaddisha, demittamman nafik chedva uvirkan lechullehu butzinin, vechahana illaa (minneh) itattar bingidu demishcha, uvegin kach kahana, dirvu mishcha itnegid aleh kegavvna dilella, bae leachazaa chedu, unehiru deanpin (yattir mikkolla), vela yitchaze girona beresheh, vela bilvusheh, ella lemehevi kolla shelim kegavvna dilella, vela yitchaze beh pegimu kelal, begin dela yaavid pegimu baatar ochora.

Ta chaze, ilmale elazar veitamar itchazun pegimu behahi shaata bilvushehon o berashehon, la ishtezivu behahi shaata, deha shaata kayyeyma lemebad dina. veal da tanenan, beshaata demotana ira bealma, la yittear inash garmeh lemilla bealma, begin dela yittearun aleh. bar i ittear garmeh letav, veyachil ledachyay (ladechakea) shaata, deha bezimna veshaata dedina kayyeyma bealma, man deyira beh, lakte leh veyistalak mealma. uvegin kach velo tamutu. ketiv vaachechem kol bet yisrael yivku et hasserefa, begin deinnun la atyayn missitra dechahane, vela mitzake.

Ribbi elazar patach, (Shemot 6:23) vayyikkach aharon et elisheva bat amminadav achot nachshon lo leishsha. vayyikach aharon. kolla kema deitzterich, kolla kegavvna dilella. ta chaze, reuya hayta bat sheva ledavid, miyyoma deitbere alma. reuya hayta elisheva leaharon miyyoma deitbere alma.

Ma ben hay lehay. ella kolla chad. aval hatam ledina, hacha lerachame. kad itchabbera bedavid, ledina, leaggacha keravin, leoshada damin. hacha beaharon, lishlama, lechedva, linhiru deanpin, leitbarcha. veal da itkere (hachi) hatam bat sheva, hacha elisheva. elisheva: deitchabbera bechesed, (401 chaze) bat sheva ledina, leyarta malchuta uleittakfa.

Amar ribbi shimon, ha detanenan dichtiv, (Shemot 19:19) kol hashshofar, shappir hu, veda hu yaakov, deistallak bemachashava daavahan, venafku kachada miggo shofar, deha shofar appik mayya veeshsha verucha kachada, veitavid minnayyhu kala. kach imma illaa, appik laavahan, bekal chad. umiggo machashava istelaku kachada bechad kol, vehahu kol ikre kol hashshofar, veda yaakov dechalil laavahan kachada, veikkere kol.
Utere kale ninhu, deha miggo kala, nafik kala. aval kol chad deikre kol hashshofar, umehacha nafku shear kolot, miggo hahu shofar beziuuga
1110: Demachashava. veshiva kolot ninhu, denafkin beziuuga demachashava beshshofar, veda shofar deashke lon veravvi lon laavahan bekadmita, ulevatar livnin, veha ukemuha milla.

Ta chaze, vayyikkach aharon et elisheva, levassema lah, lemechede lah, lechabbera la bemalka, beziuuga shelim, leishtakkecha birchan lealmin kullehu, al yede deaharon. begin kach, bae kahana leishtakkecha binhiru deanpin, bechedu, kolla kegavvna dilella, deha al yedoy birchan vechedvavn mishtakkeche. veal da itrachaka minneh dina verugeza veatzivu, begin dela yitpegam mehahu atar deitketar beh. veal da vaachechem kol bet yisrael yivku et hasserefa, velav kahana. alayyhu ketiv (Devarim 33:11) barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze vegomer.

(Vayikra 10:9) yayin veshechar al tesht atta uvanecha ittach vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda, miggo parsheta da shamenan, denadav vaavihu revi chamra havo, middeazhar lechahane beha. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 104:15) veyayin yesammach levav enosh vegomer, i bae kahana lemechde uleishtakkecha binhiru deanpin yattir mikkolla, amay asir leh chamra, deha chedu beh ishtechach, nehiru deanpin beh ishtechach.

Ella sheruta dechamra chedvavta. sofeh atzivu. veod deyyayin missitra delevae ate, meatar dechamra share, deha orayyta vechamra deorayyta, missitra digvura hu. (sefer acher sefeh atzivu, vechahana sheruta vesiyyuma bae chedvata unehiru deanpin, yayin ate missitra delevae) vesitra dechahana mayin tzelilin nehirin.

Ribbi yose amar kol chad ozif lechavreh, vechalil kolla da beda, uvegin kach, chamra share chedvavta, begin dechalil miggo mayya, ulevatar ahdar leatreh, veatziv veragiz vedain dina. (vechahana sheruta vesiyyuma bae chedvata unehiru deanpin)

Ribbi abba amar, meatar chad nafku, yayin veshemen umayim. mayim veshemen limina, natle kahane veyarte lon, veshemen yattir mikkolla. deihu chedvavta sheruta vesiyyuma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh yored al hazzakan zekan aharon. veyayin lismala, yarte levae, learma kala ulezammera, vela lishtuk, deha chamra la shatik lealmin, veshemen bachashay hu tadir.

Ma ben hay lehay. ella, shemen deihu bachashay bilchishu tadir, ate missitra demachashava, deihu bilchishu tadir vela ishtema, vehu bachashay, veal da hu mimina. veyayin deihu (korach 176) learma kala, vela shatik lealmin, ate missitra deimma, veyartin levae listar semala, vekayyme lezammera learma kala, vekayyme bedina. uvegin kach ketiv, (Devarim 21:5) veal pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga.

Begin kach, kahana kad yiul lemakdesha lemiflach pulechana, asir leh lemishte chamra, deha ovadoy bachashay innun, uvachashay (sefer acher itchaze) atan veitkevvavn, (sefer acher uvachashay itkevavn bema deitkavvevn) vezivvivg leman dezivvivg, venagid birchan lealmin kullehu, vecholla bachashay, (veod) deovadoy kullehu beraza. vechamra megalle razin hu, deha kol ovadoy learma kala kaim.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak havo azle bearcha, mibbe mironya letzippori, vahava ravyay chad shechiach begavvavn (sefer acher legabbayyhu), bechamra bekinta deduvesha amar ribbi yehuda nema milla deorayyta venezil.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Shir HaShirim 7:10) vechikkech keyen hattov holech ledodi lemesharim vegomer. vechikkech keyen hattov, da yena deorayyta, deihu tav. deha yena ochora lav ihu tav, veyena deorayyta, tav lecholla. tav lealma da, vetav lealma deate. veda hu yena denicha leh lekudesha berich hu yattir mikkolla, uvizchu da, man dimravvi miyena deorayyta, yittear lealma deate, veyizke leachayay, kad yokim kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay. amar ribbi yehuda, dovev sifte yeshenim, ha tanenan deafillu behahu alma, yizke lemile beorayyta, hada hu dichtiv dovev sifte yeshenim.
Amar hahu ravya, i ketiv vechikkech miyyen hattov, havina amre hache. aval keyen hattov ketiv, vela miyyen. ashgechu beh, amar ribbi yehuda, beri ema millach, deshappir ka amrat.
Amar, ana shemana, deman deishtaddal beorayyta, vedavik ba, vehahi milla deorayyta ishtema befumeh, vela lachish lah
1111: Bilchishu, ella arim kaleh ba. deorayyta hachi baya learma kala, dichtiv, (Mishlei 1:21) berosh homiyyot tikra, learama rinna deorayyta, vela bilchishu. keyen hattov, kachamar tav dela shatik. vehu atid learama kala, kad yippuk mehay alma. holech ledodi lemesharim, dela yiste limina velismala, la yishtekach deyimche bidoy. dovev sifte yeshenim, afillu behahu alma shifvavteh merachshan orayyta.

Tu shemana vechikkech keyen hattov, hay kera likkeneset yisrael ittemar, uvetushebachta ittemar. i hachi, man hu dimshabbach lah behay. i kudesha berich hu, mahu holech ledodi, holech elay mibbae leh.

Ella vadday kudesha berich hu ka meshabbach lah likkeneset yisrael, kema dehi ka meshabbachat leh, dichtiv chikko mamtakkim, kach kudesha berich hu meshabbach le likkeneset yisrael. (dichtiv) vechikkech keyen hattov, yen hattov: dehu chamra demintera. holech ledodi: da yitzchak, deikre yedid mibbeten. lemesharim: kema deat amer, (Tehillim 99:4) atta konanta mesharim, leitkallela semala bimina. veda hu mesharim, divgin chedvavta dehahu chamar tav, itkelil semala bimina, vechaddan kolla. (dovev sifte yeshanim) deha kolla mitare bechedvavn uvirkan, vealmin kullehu mishtakkeche bechedu, umitare learka birchan letatta.

Atu ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak venashsheku leh resheh, vechaddu immeh, amru leh ma shemach. amar leho yesa. amru ribbi yesa tehe. yattir tehe shechiach bealma merabbi yesa chavrana, deistallak mibbenana. amru leh uman avuch. amar leho, aftar mealma, vahava olif li kol yoma 3 millin deorayyta, uvelelya 3 millin dechachmeta deaggadta. vehane mile olifna meabba, vehasheta diuri bechad bar nash, vesalik li meorayyta. vaana azil kol yoma laavidta, uvechol yoma ahadarna innun millin deolifna meabba.

Amru leh hahu bar nash yada beorayyta. amar lon lav. sava hu, vela yada levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, veit leh benin, vela shavvi lon beve rav. amar ribbi yehuda (nusach acher i lav hachi hava) i la hava hachi, hava ailna legabbe hay kefar lemallela alach, hasheta asir lan lemecheze anpoy. shede chamara minach, veat zil legabban. amru leh man hu avuch. amar ribbi zeera dichfar ramin.

Shama ribbi yehuda uvacha, amar ana havina beveteh, veolifna minneh 3 millin bechassa divracha, veolifna minneh bemaase bereshit tere. amar ribbi yitzchak, uma mehay ravya bereh olifna, minneh la kol shekken. azlu veachidu bideh. chamu chad chakal veyatvu tamman. amru leh ema chad milla, meinnun deolif lach avuch bemaase bereshit.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 1:21) vayivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim vegomer. vayivra elohim, kol atar dedina elohim ikre. vehahu atar illaa atar denafku minneh, hachi kare leh hacha. veaf al gav derachame hu, mineh nafku dinin, uveh talyayn.

Et hattanninim haggedolim, illen avahan. deinnun mitshakyayn bekadmita, umishtarshin al kolla. veet kol nefesh hachayya haromeset, veet kol nefesh hachayya, da nefesh, dehahi eretz illaa appikat mehahi chayya illaa al kolla, dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya. veda ihi nefesh deadam kadmaa, demashich begavih. haromeset: da hi chayya derachasha bechol turin (sefer acher sitrin), leella vetatta. asher shartzu hammayim, dehahu nahar illaa nagid venafik meeden, veashke lehay ilana, leishtarsha besharshoy al kolla, uleishtakkecha beh mezona lecholla.

Davar acher hachayya haromeset, da hu david malka, dichtiv beh (Tehillim 118:17) lo amut ki echye vegomer. veet kol of kanaf leminehu, illen kol innun malachin kaddishin, demishtakkeche lekaddesha shema demarehon bechol yoma veyoma, dichtiv behu (Yeshayahu 6:2) shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim leechad. uminnehon tasin bealma lemebad reuta demarehon, kol chad vechad kadka chaze. amar ribbi yehuda, vday kol kach lehay ravya la itchaze, aval ana chame beh delaatar illaa yistelak.
1112: Vadday. hachayya (haromeset) da hi chayya illaa al kolla, deha ochora eretz karyeh kera. hacha dichtiv vehaof yirev baaretz, baaretz vday, vela bamayim. deha hahu nahar, nagid venafik veashke, bela peruda, ad hahu atar deikre eretz, umittamman ketiv umishsham yippared vegomer. vehaof, vehahu of behay eretz talyayn veitshshakyayn, veda hu dichtiv vehaof yirev baaretz. kamu veazlu. amar ribbi yehuda, nishtattef lehay ravya immana, vechol chad vechad lema milla deorayyta.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:Adonai) sammechuni baashishot rappeduni battappuchim vegomer. hay kera ha ittemar veshappir. aval keneset yisrael kaamar da begaluta. sammechuni, mahu sammechuni. ella man denafil bae leasmecha leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:14) somech Adonai lechol hannoflim vegomer. uvegin kach, keneset yisrael denafla, dichtiv, (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum, baya leasmecha, vehi amra sammechuni. leman amra. leyisrael benaha deinnun begaluta immah.

Uvemma baashishot. illen innun avahan, deinnun itmalyayn bekadmita, mehahu chamar tav demintera. vechad innun itmalyayn, ha birchaan mishtakkeche legabbah, al yeda dechad darga deihu tzaddik. uman deyada leyachada shema kaddisha, af al gav devirkan la mishtakkeche bealma, ihu samich vesaid lah likkeneset yisrael begaluta.

Rappeduni battappuchim, kolla chad kema deamaran, aval raza da, ashisha: ayel chamra. tappuach: appik chamra, umechavvivn reuta. veal da ashishot vetappuchim. ashishot, leravava mechamra. tappuchim, lechavvevna reuta dela yazik chamra. vechol da lamma. ki cholat ahava ani, begaluta. uman dimyayched shema kaddisha, bae leyachada dina berachame, uleachlela lon kadka chaze, leitbassema uleittakna kolla kedka yeot, veda samich lah likkeneset yisrael begaluta.

Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Devarim 32:38) asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nesicham. zakkain innun yisrael deinnun kaddishin, vekudesha berich hu bae lekaddesha lon. ta chaze yisrael kaddishin, kol chayye alma deyartin, kolla talyayn behahu alma deate, begin deihu chayyin decholla, leella vetatta, vehu atar, deyayin demintera share (veikre yayin) umittamman nafkin chayyin ukedusha lecholla. veyayin deyisrael begin yayin deyisrael ochora, veda beda talya. deha yisrael leella, beh natil chayyin, uvegin kach ikre etz chayim, etz mehahu atar deikre chayyim, venafke mittamman chayyin, veal da mevarchin leh lekudesha berich hu beyayin. veyayin deyisrael letatta kehay gavvna.

Oved avodat kochavim umazzalot, deihu mesaav, uman dekariv bahadeh yisteav, kad yikrav beyayin deyisrael, ha isteav veasir, kol shekken hahu yayin deihu avid. veal da la tema deda hu bilchodoy, ella kol ma deavde yisrael letatta, kolla hu keen dugema dilella, kol shekken yayin, dekae baatar illaa, dugema deyayin demintera.

Begin kach yisrael shatyayn yayin deyisrael, deitavid kadka chaze bikdushsha, kegavvna deyisrael leella, deshate veishtarsha veitbarcha behahu yayin illaa kaddisha, vela shatan yayin deitavid bimsaavuta, umissitra dimsaavuta, deha beh sharya rucha dimsaavuta. (velav hu missitra deyisrael) uman deshate leh (bahadayyhu), isteav rucheh, veisteav ihu, velav hu missitra deyisrael, velet leh chulaka bealma deate. deha hahu alma deate, yayin demintera ihu.

Veal da yisrael kaddishin, bayayn lenatra da al kolla, begin deitkeshar baatar dealma deate. uvegin kach, beyayin itberich kudesha berich hu yattir mikkolla, begin deihu chadde lesitra semala, uvego chedvavta dileh itkelil bimina. vechad itavid kolla yemina, keden shema kaddisha bechedu, uvirkan mishtakkeche bechullehu almin. uveovada diltatta yittear ovada dilella, veal da mezammene yayin lokovel yayin.

Uvegin deihu menatra leella, bae lenatra leh letatta, vechol netiru dileh kedushsha hu leyisrael, uman defagim leh letatta besitra dimsaavuta, yisteav ihu behay alma, velet leh chulaka bealma deate, atar dehahu yayin demintera sharya. hu la natir leh, la yitnetar hu lealma deate.
1113: Hu saiv leh, yisavun leh behahu alma, la yehe leh chulaka behahu yayin dealma deate. zakkain innun yisrael, dimkaddeshe nafshayyhu bikdushsha illaa, venatre ma deitzterich leitnatra, umekaddeshe lemalka bintiru illaa da. zakkain innun bealma den uvealma deate.

Patach hahu ravya veamar, (Mishlei 29:4) melech vemishpat yaamid aretz vegomer. man melech. da kudesha berich hu. bemishpat da yaakov, deihu kelala daavahan. veish terumot, terumat ketiv, kema deat amer (Shemot 25:3) vezot hatteruma. veish terumot, da esav, devae al terumot veal maasrot kol yoma, vela avid midi. veish terumot delav ihu mishpat. deha teruma istalkuta derachame, begin da la atya bemmishpat, kema deat amer (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat, veal da, veish terumot yehersenna.

Vei tema, ha david malka ish teruma hava, ella berachame. velo od ella (sefer acher david malka ish teruma hava veara itkayyeyma begineh hachi hu vadday. aval kolla berachame hava) deha ketiv (Yeshayahu 55:3) chasde david hanneemanim, kema deitdevak behay, itdevak behay.

Ta chaze, kol yomoy dedavid malka, hava mishtaddal (begin) dehay teruma, yitkeshar bemmishpat, veyizdavvgun kachada. (begin deyitkayyem beara) ata shelomo vezivvivg lon kachada, vekayyeyma sihara beashlemuta, vekayyeyma ara bekiyyuma. ata tzidkiyyahu veafrish lon, veishtearat ara bela mishpat, veitpegimat sihara, veitcharivat ara, keden veish terumat yehersenna.

Veta chaze, shemen lechahane, veyayin lelevae. la begin devayayn yayin, ella miyyayin demintera ate lesitra dilhon, lechabbera kolla kachada, ulemechede almin kullehu, leishtakkecha behu kolla, yemina usemala kalil da beda. leishtakkecha behu chavivuta decholla, urechimuta divne mehemnuta.

Man deitdevak reuteh behay, hu shelim behay alma, uvealma deate, veyishtekach kol yomoy deitdevak bitshuva, atar deyayin veshemen mishtakkeche. keden la yitdevak batar alma da, la leutra, vela lechissufa dileh. ushelomo malka tzavavch al da veamar, (Mishlei 21:17) ohev yayin vashemen, lo yaashir, deha utera ochora yizdaman leh, lemehevi leh chulaka beh, ulemehevi beh chulaka bealma deate, atar deyayin veshemen sharyayn bealma da uvealma deate. uman derachim leh lehay atar, la bae utera vela radif avatreh. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay demishtaddele beutera illaa kol yoma, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:17) lo yaarchena zahav uzechuchit utemuratah keli faz. hay behay alma. levatar, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle.

Tu patach veamar, (Shemot 24:12) vayyomer Adonai el moshe ale elay hahara vegomer. vehattora, da tora shebbichtav. vehammitzva, da tora shebbeal pe. lehorotam ketiv chaser, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 3:4) veel cheder horati. hacha it leistakkela, lehorotam demi, i tema horotam deyisrael, lav hache, deha yisrael la adkaru behay kera. ella horotam detora umitzva. umay hi. da (atar) yayin demintera. begin dechol ketiva desefer illaa tamman sharya, umittamman nafka tora, veal da karenan tora shebbichtav. veda hu asher katavti lehorotam, lehorotam vadday. (kema deat amar veel cheder horati)

Tora shebbeal pe, tora ochora, (vayyakhel 201) dekayyeyma al pe. man ihu pe. da hu daat, deihu pe desefer uchetiva. vetora da, hi tora ochora, deikre tora shebbeal pe, deihi kayyeyma al hahu pe deihi tora shebbichtav, begin kach istalik moshe becholla, al kol shear nevie mehemne, dichtiv veettena lecha, lecha dayyka.

Ketiv (Mishlei 25:4-Adonai) hago sigim mikkasef vayyetze latztzoref keli hago rasha lifne melech veyikkon bachesed kiso. ta chaze, beshaata deasgiu chayyayvin bealma, kuresyay demalka kadisha ittakkenat bedina, leisteavat (sefer acher vaashateabet) (sefer acher vekayyeyma) bedina, veshalhovoy okdin alma. uveshaata deitavar chayyayvaya mealma, keden veyikkon bachesed kiso. bachesed, vela bedina may mashma.
Mashma dealma tattaa talya bealma illaa, vealma illaa lefum arche dealma tattaa. veyikkon bachesed
1114: Kiso. man devae levarcha leh, uleatkena kuresyeh, bechesed vela bedina. may mashma. dechad ayel kahana leve makdesha, deyeul bechesed deihu mayya, vela yeul beyayin deshate deihu gevura. yeul (behay milla) bemayya, vela yeul bechamra.

Atu ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak, venashsheku resheh, umehahu yoma la itperash mibbe ribbi yehuda, vechad hava ayel leve midrasha, hava kam ribbi yehuda kammeh, amar milla olifna minneh, veyaut leanhaga beh yekar. levatar istellak ben chavrayyay, vahavu karan leh ribbi yesa, resha defattisha dematbar tinarin, veappik shalhovin lechol setar. vahava kare aleh ribbi elazar, (Yirmeyahu 1:Adonai) beterem etztzarcha babbeten yedaticha.

(Vayikra 11:1) vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon lemor alehem zot hachayya asher tochlu vegomer, may shena hacha aharon. ella begin deihu kayyeyma tadir leafresha ben misava uven dachya. dichtiv lehavedil ben hattame uven hattahor.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 34:13) mi haish hechafetz chayyim vegomer. netzor leshoncha mera vegomer. sur mera vegomer. uchetiv (Mishlei 21:23) shomer piv uleshono vegomer. mi haish hechafetz chayyim. man chayyim. ella illen chayyim deikrun alma deate, vechayyim tamman sharyayn. veal da tanenan, etz chayyim, hi ilana meinnun chayyim, ilana deitneta beinnun chayyin. veal da mi haish hechafetz chayyim ketiv.

Ohev yamim lirot tov, man yamim. ella da hu shema demalka kaddisha, daachida beinnun yomin illain, deikrun yeme hashshamayim al haaretz, yeme hashshamayim vadday, al haaretz vadday. man devae chayyim dilella, lemehevi leh chulaka behu. uman devae yomin illain leitdabbeka behu ulerachama lehu. yintar pumeh mikkolla, yintar pumeh velishaneh, yintar pumeh mimmechla umimmishteya, dimsaev lenafsha, umerachaka lebar nash meinnun chayyin umeinnun yomin, veyintar (sefer acher pumeh velishane) lishaneh mimmillin bishin, dela yisteav behu, veyitrechak minnayyhu, vela yehe leh chulaka behu.
Ta chaze, puma velishan, atar (achara) illaa hachi ikre, uvegin kach la yafgim inish pumeh velishaneh, vekol shekken leistaava nafsheh vegarmeh, begin deisteav hu bealma ochora, veha okimna.

(Vayikra 11:2) zot hachayya asher tochlu mikkol habbehema vegomer, hay kera lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. zot hachayya bekadmita, ulevatar mikkol habbehema. ella amar kudesha berich hu, bechol zimna deyisrael menatre nafshayyhu, vegarmayyhu, dela lesaava lon, vadday zot hachayya asher tochlu, yehon shechichin bikdushsha illaa, leitdabbeka bishmi, bivriru dehahi behema devarirna lechu lemechal, la tistaavu behu, vetehvon devekin bishmi.

Vechol zimna delav innun natrin nafshayyhu vegarmayyhu mimmechla umishteyya, yitdabbekun baatar ochora misava, leistaava behu. uvegin kach ketiv, zot hachayya asher tochlu mikkol, mikkol vday, deihu raza dishma kaddisha, leitdabbeka beh. mikkol habbehema asher al haaretz, begin dehay mechla dehay behema ishtechach dachya, vela yesaav lechu, yehe lechu chulaka bishmi, leitdabbeka beh.

Tu, zot hachayya asher tochlu. befaro ketiv, (Shemot 6:7) bezot teda ki ani Adonai. ha zot lokovlach, leitpara minach. uf hacha zot hachayya asher tochlu mikkol habbehema, ha zot lokovlechon, leitpara minnayychu, i tesaavun nafshechon. may taama. begin denafshata minnah havo, vei attun tesaavun lehahu dilah, ha zot lokovlayychu, i letav hi kayyeyma legabbayychu, i levish hi kayyeyma legabbayychu.
Amar ribbi elazar, zot hachayya asher tochlu mikkol habbehema, mikkol innun daachidan min setar da, share lechu lemechal, vechol innun dela atyayn
1115: Missitra da, asir lechu lemechal. begin deit beiran deatyayn missitra da, veit deatyayn missitra ochora misava. vesimana dilhon dichtiv, kol mafreset parsa. vegamrinan kullehu reshiman, vechullehu arshim lehu kera. uvegin kach, kol man deachil meinnun deatyayn missitra da misava, isteav behu, vesaiv lenafsheh deatya missitra dachya.

Rabbi shimon amar kelal kolla, kema deit eser kitrin dimhemnuta leella. kach it eser kitre decharashe mesaave letatta. vechol ma di beara, minnayyhu achidan besitra da, uminnayyhu achidan besitra ochora.

Vei tema, hay ez, desharya aleh ruach misava. lav hache. dei ruach misava sharya beh, asir lan lemechal. ella aberan begavavyyhu, veyitchazun lokovlehon, vela sharya ledayyeyra behu, dechad innun sharyayn, ruach ochora abar alayyhu, uferishan miggarmayyhu. uvegin kach itchazun lokovlayyhu, umekatrege begavavyyhu, vela shalte behu begarmayyhu, veal da shari lan lemechal.
Ta chaze, kevan deatyayn leshalletaa behu, aavar rucha chada, zakfan ayynin vechaman reshimin dilhon, veitparshan minnayyhu, aval itchazo lokovlehon, vela asire lan lemechal.

Ben bivire, ben bechevavta, ben beofe, ben benune yamma, bechullehu itchazun yemina usemala (rachame vedina), vechol man deate missitra dimina, (missitra derachame) share lan lemechal. vechol innun deatyayn missitra dismala (missitra dedina), kullehu asir lan lemechal. begin dedarga (sefer acher dageramea) dechullehu misava, vechullehu misavin, veruach misava sharya begavavyyhu, vedare behu. veal da rucha kaddisha deyisrael, la yitarav behu, vela yisteav behu, begin deyishtakkechun kaddishin, veyishtemodun leella vetatta. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, demalka kaddisha itree behu, uvae ledakkea lehu, ulekaddesha lehu al kolla, begin daachidan beh.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar, i kudesha berich hu mitpaar behu beyisrael, hech atyayn leistaava uleitdabbeka besitra misava. veal da ketiv, vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani velo teshakketzu et nafshotechem vegomer, man deihu bediyyukena demalka, la live leh leafresha meorchoy demalka. uvegin kach rashim lehu kudesha berich hu leyisrael, kol innun deatyayn missitra da, vechol innun deatyayn missitra ochora. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dichtiv behu, (Yeshayahu 61:9) kol roehem yakkirum (58 amud alef, 80) ki hem zera berach Adonai, berach Adonai mammash, berach Adonai becholla.

Veta chaze, kol man deachil meinnun maachale daasire, itdevak besitra ochora, vegail nafsheh vegarmeh, veruach mesaav sharya aleh, veachze garmeh delet leh chulaka beelaha illaa, vela ate missitreh, vela itdevak beh. vei yippuk hachi mehay alma, achidan beh kol innun daachidan bistar (sefer acher deatyayn missetar) dimsaava, umesaavin leh vedayynin leh kebar nash deihu gaala demareh, gaala behay alma, vegaala bealma deate.

Veal da ketiv, venitmetem bam bela 1, dela ishtechach asuvta legiuleh, vela nafik mimmesaavuteh lealmin. vavy lon, vavy lenafshayyhu, dela yitdabbekun bitzrora dechayye lealmin, deha isteavu. vavy legarmayyhu, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:24) ki tolatam lo tamut vegomer, vehayu deraon lechol basar. may deraon. sirchona. man garim leh, hahu setar deitdabbak beh.

Yisrael atyayn missitra dimina, i itdabbekan bistar semala, ha pagmin listar da, ufagmin legarmayyhu, ufagmin lenafshayyhu, pegimin bealma den, ufegimin, bealma deate. kol shekken man deitdabbak bistar dimsaava, decholla achid da beda, uchetiv (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha vegomer.
Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Kohelet 6:7) kol amal haadam lefihu vegomer. istakkalna bemille dishlomo malka, vechullehu achidan bechachma illaa. kol amal haadam lefihu, hay kera, beshaata dedayynin leh
1116: Lebar nash behahu alma ketiv, kol hahu dina, vechol may desavil behahu alma, venakmin minneh nikmata dealma. lefihu: begin pihu, dela natir leh, vesaiv leh lenafsheh, vela itdevak besitra dechayye, besitra dimina. vegam hanefesh lo timale, la tishtelim dinaha lealam ulealme almin. davar acher lo timale, la tishtelim lesalleka leatraha lealmin, begin deha isteavat, veitdabbekat besitra ochora.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, kol man deisteav behu, keillu palach leavoda zara, deihu (Devarim 17) toavat Adonai, uchetiv lo tochal kol toeva. man defalach leavoda zara, nafik missitra dechayye, nafik mershuta kaddisha, veayil birshuta ochora. uf man deisteav behane mechle, nafik missitra dechayye, venafik mershu kaddisha, veayil birshuta ochora. velo od, ella deisteav behay alma, uvealma deate. veal da venitmetem bam ketiv bela 1.

Uchetiv, velo teshakketzu et nafshotechem babbehema uvaof uvechol asher tirmos haadama asher hivdalti etchem letamme. may letamme. letamme leammin ovde avoda zara, deha innun misavin, umissitra dimsaava ka atyayn. vechol chad itdabbak beatreh.

Ribbi elazar hava yativ kame deribbi shimon avoy, amar leh, ha detanenan zammin kudesha berich hu ledakkaa lehu leyisrael, bemma. amar leh, bemma dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem vegomer. kevan deitdakkean mitkaddeshan, veyisrael deitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, kodesh ikrun, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, uchetiv (Shemot 22:30) veanshe kodesh tihyun li, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu kaamar alayyhu, vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai, begin dichtiv (Devarim 10) uvo tidbak, uchetiv (Tehillim 147:20) lo asa chen lechol goy umishpatim bal yedaum haleluyah.

Raya mehemna (nidpas 491 278 amud bet) dagim vachagavim, enan teunin shechita, ella asifatam hi hamatteret otam. hachi mare metivta, en tzerichin shechita, ella deittemar behon, (Bereshit 49:33) vayyigva vayyiasef el ammav. ma nune yamma, chiutan beyamma. af talmide (tikun 56) chachamim, mare matnitin, chiyyutayyhu beorayyta, vei itparshan minnah, miyyad metim. (nusach acher tenain) tanenan dematnitin, devah itrabbu kenune yamma, vei innun divyabbeshta yaalun lemayya, vela yadin leshatta, innun mayytin. aval adam (deinnun mare kabbala inun leella), deihu leella mikkullehu, ittemar beh (Bereshit 1:26) veyirdu vidgat hayyam uveof hashshamayim.

Deinnun mare matnitin taninayya, hattannin haggadol, (Yeshayahu 27:1) nachash bariach, lokovel (Shemot 26:28) vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim, bezimna detanninan mare mishna it behon machaloket, umakshin da leda, bala lechavreh. vehay ihu talmid zeer shello higgia lehoraa umore, chayyayv mita. vei innun shavin da leda, veit behon machaloket, vekusheya, ittemar behon (sefer acher levassof) (Bamidbar 21:14) et vahev besufa, okmuha ahava besufa. (ad kan 310).
1117: Bi ella behechaleh, kerativ velo anani. deha beni ammin ochoranin yativna, vekaleh la shamin ella benoy. dichtiv, (Devarim 4:33) hashama am kol elohim vegomer.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, al mishkavi ballelot. amra cheneset yisrael al mishkavi itraamna kammeh, diyhe mizdevvavg ammi lemechde li, ulevarcha li, bechedu shelim. dehachi tanenan demiziuuga demalka bikkeneset yisrael, kamma tzaddikim yartu yerutat achasanta kaddisha, vechamma birchan mishtakkeche bealma.

Ribbi abba hava azil lichfar kanyya, (sefer acher bifrakmatya) limarta delud. vahavu immeh ribbi yose veribbi chiyyay. amar ribbi yose, ketiv, (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah vegomer. eshet chayil, da keneset yisrael. ucherakav beatzmotav mevisha. illen (nusach acher da mehemanuta dishar) ammin ovde avoda zara, dekudesha berich hu la yachil lemisbal lon bealma, kema deat amer, (Vayikra 20:23) vaakutz bam. kehane kotzin veguvin dedachakin leh lebar nash vela yachil lemisbal lon. amar ribbi abba, hachi hu vadday, eshet chayil, da keneset yisrael, dehi gevirta mikkamma chayyaylin vechamma mashshiryayn demishtakkeche bealma, ateret balah, kema deat amer, ateret tiferet, vecholla chad. (33 vechulei eshet chayil da keneset yisrael deha beziuuga demalka afikat kema chayyaylin kema mashshiryayn kema tzaddikim bealma vechullehu ikrun banim lekudesha berich hu velichneset yisrael kema dichtiv 4 banim attem laAdonai elohechem.) ad dahavo azle, amar ribbi abba kol chad lema milla, bikkeneset yisrael.

Ribbi abba patach veamar. (Mishlei 31:10) eshet chayil mi yimtza, da keneset yisrael, deihi eshet chayil, kema deamaran. mi yimtza, kema deat amer, asher yimtza etchem beacharit hayyamim. (33 mi yimmatze leaggacha beh kerava) mi yimtza, man yizke lemehevi be bishlimu, uleishtakkecha immah tadir.

Verachok mippeninim michrah, michrah, mikchah mibbae leh. ella, lechol innun dela itdabbekan bah bishlimu, vela shelemin bahadah, hi machra lon veasgera lon bida deamamin ochoranin. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 12:9) vayyaazvu bene yisrael et Adonai vayimkor otam beyad sisra. ucheden kullehu rechikin meillen peninim illain kaddishin, dela yehe chulaka behu. hada hu dichtiv verachok mippeninim michrah.

Ribbi chiyyay patach kera avatreh veamar, batach bah lev balah veshalal lo yechsar. batach bah lev balah, da kudesha berich hu, divgine kach mane le al alma, leitdabbera alah, kol ziyyunin dileh afkid bidaha, vechol innun maggiche kerava, veal da, veshalal lo yechsar.

Ribbi yose patach kera avatreh, veamar, gemalathu tov velo ra kol yeme chayyeha. gemalathu tov, hi zeminat tav lealma, zeminat tav lehechala demalka velivne hechaleh. velo ra. begin dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:9) veetz haddaat tov vara, tov ematay, bezimna deinnun yeme hashshamayim, naharin ala, umizdavvevgan immah kedka yeot, deinnun yeme chayyeha. begin deetz hachayyim, shadar lah chayyim, venahir lah. uvehahu zimna gemalathu tov vela ra. amar ribbi abba shappir hu, vechullehu kerae bichneset yisrael ittemaru.

(Vayikra 12:2) ishsha ki tazria. tanenan, ishsha mazraat techilla yoledet zachar. ribbi acha amar, ha tanenan, dekudesha berich hu gazar al hahi tippa, i ihu dechar i ihi nukeba, veat amrat isha mazraat techilla yoledet zachar. amar ribbi yose, vadday kudesha berich hu avchin ben tippa didchura uven tippa denukeba, uvegin deavchin leh, gazar aleh, i lihevi dechar o nukeba.

Amar ribbi acha, veyalda zachar, vechi kevan demazraat yoledet, dichtiv, veyalda (ella), hay kera hachi mibbae leh, isha ki tahar veyalda zachar. (sefer acher tazria veyihye zachar) mahu, ki tazria veyalda. amar ribbi yose, itteta, min yoma deitabberat ad yoma deyolidat let lah befuma, ella yelidu dilah i lihevi dechar, veal da, ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar.
Ishsha ki tazria. ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai. kama saggiin ovadohi demalka kaddisha bealma, metal lebar nash denatil bidohi kama
1118: Makturin kachada, vezara lon bezimna chada, ulevatar nafik kol chad vechad bilchodoy. kach kudesha berich hu avid ovadohi bechachma, uvechachma natil kolla kachada vezara lon, ulevatar nafku kol chad vechad bezimneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) kullam bechachma asita.

Amar ribbi abba, ma rabbu maasecha Adonai, kama saggiin innun ovadohi demalka kaddisha, vechullehu, setimin bechachma, hada hu dichtiv kullam bechachma asita. kullehu bechachma kelilan, vela nafke levar ella bishvilin yedian, legabbe bina. umittamman, itavidu kolla veittekanu, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:3) uvitvuna yitkonan. veal da kullam bechachma asita, bevina.

Mala haaretz, haaretz: da keneset yisrael, demittamman itmalleya mikkolla, kema deat amer (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vegomer. kinyanecha. dehi appikat lon levatar, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, baAdonai beraam. begine kach mala haaretz kinyanecha.

Ta chaze, beshaata devar nash ate leitkadsha leizdavvevga benukeveh, (bechavavna) biruta kaddisha dileh, ittear aleh rucha (achara) kaddisha, kalil dechar venukeba. veramiz kudesha berich hu lechad shelucha memana al idduyehon divne nasha, umane bideh hahu rucha, veoda leh, lean atar yifkod leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 3:3) vehallayla amar hora gaver. hallayla amar, lehahu memana, hora gaver mippelanya, vekudesha berich hu afkid leh, lehahu rucha, kol ma deafkid, veha ukemuha.

Keden rucha nachta, vechad tzulema immeh, (104 amud bet) hahu dekaim bediukeneh leella, behahu tzulema itbere (sefer acher itrabbe), behahu tzulema azil behay alma. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 39:7) ach betzelem yithallech ish. beod dehay tzulema ishtechach (vaychi 220 amud alef) immeh debar nash, (betzulema dileh) kaim behay alma, demitchabberan kachada (sefer acher ishtechach immeh bar nash kaim behay alma uteren inun demitchabberan kachada), ushelomo malka azhar livne nasha veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:17) ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim, tere.

Uvesifra decharashin deashmeday, ashkachna deinnun deyade (sefer acher devau) lecharsha charashin mistar semala, uleitdabbeka behu, yekum linhora dishraga, o baatar deyitchazun innun tzulemin dileh, veyema innun millin demitattekne leinnun charashin, veyikre lon, leinnun sitrin misavin, bishmahan misavin dilhon, veyazmmin (veyome) tzulemin dileh leinnun dekare, veyema dehu ittakkan biruteh lehu lefikkudayyhu, vehahu bar nash nafak mershu demareh ufikdona dileh, yahav listar misava.

Uveinnun millin decharashin deihu yema, veyazmin (nusach acher veyome) lon letzuleme, itchazun teren ruchin umittakkenin beinnun tzulemin dileh, bechezu divne enasha, umodin leh millin leavasha, umillin leotava, lezimnin yedian. veillen tere ruchin, dela itkelilu bichlala degufa, hasheta itkelilan beillen tzulemin, umittakkenan behu umodin leh levar nash millin leavasha, veda hu denafik mershuta demareh, ufikdona dileh, yahiv listar misava.

Ta chaze, asir leh levar nash leashdaa mane deveta, uleafkeda leh lesitra ochora, dela itzterich, o milla ochora dichvavteh, (sefer acher deveteh lekabbela leh) deha kama gardine nimusin zeminin lehahu milla lekabbela leh, umehahu zimna, la sharu aleh birchan, deha missitra ochora hu. kol shekken man deazmin biruteh al hahu tivu illaa dileh, leochora ulesitra ochora. deha, mehahu deazmin leh havi.

Vechad kerivu yomin debar nash lenafka mehay alma, hahu tzulema illaa deyahave leh, atya hahu rucha bisha dehava mitdabbak beh bechol yoma, venatil leh lehahu tzulema, veittakkan beh veazil leh, vela itchazar beh bebar nash lealmin. keden yinda deha itdachya hu mikkolla.

Ta chaze, beshaata denishmeta nachta leaala leh behay alma, nachta beginta deeden deara, vechamat yekara deruchehon detzaddikayyay kayymin shurin shurin. levatar azla laggehinnam, vechamat lehu lerashiayyay detzavvchin vavy vavy, vela merachame alayyhu. uvecholla ashidu bah sahaduta, vehahu tzulema kaddisha kayyeyma aleh, ad denafik lealma.
1119: Kad nafik lealma, izdeman hahu tzulema legabbeh, veishtetaf bahaddeh, veitrabbe immeh. kema deittemar, (Tehillim 39:7) ach betzelem yithallech ish. uvehahu tzelem ishtattafu (ishtechachu) yomoy devar nash, vetalyayn beh, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 8:9) ki temol anachnu velo neda ki tzel yamenu ale aretz. ki tzel yamenu vadday. umin yoma demitabbera itteta ad yoma deolidat, la yadin bene nasha ovadoy dekudesha berich hu, kamma innun ravrevin, vechamma innun illain. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai vegomer.

Ta chaze, kol ruchin dealma kelilan dechar venukeba, vechad nafkin, dechar venukeba nafkin, ulevatar mitparshan bearchayyhu, i zache bar nash, levatar mizdavvevge kachada. vehayeynu bat zugo, umitchabberan beziuuga (sefer acher begavvna) chad becholla, rucha vegufa. dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah. may leminah. hahu rucha debar nash denafik zugeh dedame leh.

Umay haaretz, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 139:15) rukkamti betachtiyyot aretz. veha ukemuha. totze haaretz vadday, deha minnah nafkin nefesh chayya, kema deokimna, da rucheh deadam kadmaa, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:3) umipperi haetz asher betoch haggan. umipperi haetz, da kudesha berich hu, asher betoch haggan, asher betoch haishsha, tanenan, hayeynu, ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar, ketiv. vela kalil dechar venukeba, kefum orchoy dealma, deinnun, garmu leh, dela mitchabberan, kama denafkan milleella zugot.

Begin deadam kadmaa, veziuvg dileh, chavu lekudesha berich hu, veal da mitparshin, kad nafkin milleella, ad dehava raava kamme kudesha berich hu, i zacha bar nash, yahavin leh zugato, vei la, mafrishin le minneh, veyahavin lah leochora, molidin benin dela kedka yeot. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 6:3) lo yadon ruchi vaadam. may ruchi, rucho mibbae leh, innun teren ruche, denafke zugot, la yedunun kachada, veal da ketiv, veyalda zachar, vela kalil dechar venukeba, kefum orchoy dealma, deinnun garmu.

Ribbi elazar amar lav hachi, deha kolla, dechar venukeba kelilan kachada, umitparshan levatar, aval veyalda zachar, kelilan kachada missitra dimina, veim nekeva teled, kelilan bechad nukeba udechar missitra semala, deshalta setar semala al setar yemina yattir, udechura itkafya bimina dela shalta, ucheden hahu dechar denafik miggo nukeba, missetar semala, kol orchoy kenukeba (velo ikre dechar), aval dechar denafik miggo yemina, hu shalta, venukeba denafka minneh itkafya, deha setar semala la shalta, veal da veyalda zachar ketiv.

Vechamma elef verivvan nafke bezimna chada lealma. umin yoma deafkat lon, la ikrun nafshan, ad deityayshshevan begufa. vechamma hu, 33 yamim. hayeynu dichtiv, usheloshim yom usheloshet yamim vegomer. vetama shivat yamim, deha kol shivat yamim la alin ruchin legabbah, leitkashshera bah, vechol illen shivat yamim, rucha azla begufa, leashkecha atreh. ucheden ketiv, (Vayikra 22:27) vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo.

Uveyoma teminaa, ithadaru rucha vegufa leitchazaa kame matronita, uleitkashshera bah, uvidchura, begufa uverucha. usheloshim yom usheloshet yamim teshev al deme tohora, leityayshsheva rucha begufa. veg yamim may avidtayyhu. ella sheloshet yamim demila, deravya kaiv, verucha la sharya madoreh begufa kishar yomin, veal da usheloshim yom usheloshet yamim teshev bidme tohora.

Bidme tohora bekadmita, ulevatar yeme tohora. bidme tohora, illen, deme mila, dama batar dama deate meravya, vekudesha berich hu natir leinnun deme kol illen yomin, hada hu dichtiv, teshev bidme tohora. tohora setam, vela adkir hei batraa, dela tema tohora dematronita, ella tohora setam, deme tohora ikrun illen deme dachya.
(Vayikra 12:4) bechol kodesh lo tigga veel hammikdash vegomer. ta chaze, bechol yoma veyoma, keneset yisrael, natla mibbe malka mezona leruchehon divne nasha, vezanat

Raya mehemna (Vayikra 12:3) uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar arlato. pikkuda da, lemigzar litmanyya yomin geziru dekkayyayma kaddisha. raza illaa, dichtiv, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam. leman, leinnun yereav innun dachale chataa, deha raza dekkayyayma kaddisha la itchazi legallaa bar lehu. veraza dekkayyayma kaddisha, ha ukemuha veittemar bechamma duchetin.

Veraza da, lach yomin, ihu chiuva al alma, lechol amma kaddisha. dichtiv, uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar arlato. yom hashshemini, da hu at kayyayma kaddisha, veihu teminaa lechol dargin. ugeziru dehahu kayyayma, leabera hahu arla.
